descriptionHtml:

The Experience

The Global Incentive Compensation (GIC) team at Salesforce is a global leader for sales compensation in the technology industry. We manage the sales compensation for all Salesforce, end-to-end - from designing the sales compensation plan to enable the company's go-to-market strategy to administering the payment so that our sales teams get paid on time.

We are currently hiring for an Senior Data Analyst, Global Incentive Compensation Analytics. This highly technical role will focus on generating deeper insights through sophisticated analysis and scientific modeling. You will support strategic compensation plan design decisions through data-driven recommendations, leveraging advanced statistical methods to assess the effectiveness of our existing programs. You will partner closely with stakeholders across the business to determine how best to align our plans with Salesforce's strategic direction.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a dynamic, data-driven environment, demonstrates natural curiosity, and is capable of building models that influence decision-makers.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Advanced Modeling & Simulation: Build and deploy scientific and predictive models using Python to simulate the financial and behavioral impacts of proposed compensation plan changes, providing analytics and data-backed business cases during the annual company GTM planning cycle.
  • Deep-Dive Analytics: Go beyond standard reporting to uncover hidden trends, performing sophisticated statistical analyses to evaluate the true effectiveness and ROI of various Incentive Compensation programs.
  • Data Pipeline & Automation: Extract, manipulate, and transform large datasets using advanced SQL and Python to automate deep insight generation, moving away from manual Excel-based processes.
  • Strategic Partnership: Serve as the dedicated technical analytics partner for aligned GTM organizations, translating complex scientific models into actionable business recommendations to evaluate the impact of compensation plan changes. Forecasting: Track commission costs by developing robust predictive algorithms that forecast future GTM performance and commission payouts.
  • Pay-for-Performance Framework: against quota attainment, utilizing advanced data modeling to optimize commission multipliers and strategically alignDesign and build a comprehensive framework to evaluate current payout rates
  • compensation structures across various roles and performance tiers.



You're Our Person If...

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related highly quantitative field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of related experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, or highly technical quantitative analysis.
  • Advanced Programming: Proficiency in Python (or R) for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and building scientific models.
  • SQL/Snowflake: Advanced proficiency in SQL/Snowflake, including complex query authoring, optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Data Visualization: Proficiency in building sophisticated, automated dashboards in Tableau or a similar tool.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: Ability to independently address complex analytical requests: understand the ask, structure the data pipeline, perform advanced statistical analyses, validate assumptions, and output reliable scientific models.
  • Communication & Storytelling: Ability to synthesize complex data and scientific methodologies into simple, consumable deliverables with clear takeaways, influencing decision making and justifying recommendations across diverse audiences.



Even Better If...

  • Industry Knowledge: A general understanding of how a SaaS GTM engine functions is preferred.
  • CRM: Knowledge of Salesforce products and/or CRM infrastructure preferred

Overview

Salesforce and Google Cloud have embarked on a groundbreaking partnership worth $2.5 billion to revolutionize customer relationship management (CRM) through advanced artificial intelligence (AI). By integrating Google's Gemini AI models into Salesforce's Agentforce platform, we're enabling businesses to harness multi-modal AI capabilities—processing images, audio, and video—to deliver unparalleled customer experiences. Join our team of talented engineers and help us advance the integration of Salesforce applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will have the unique opportunity to work at the forefront of IDP, AI and cloud computing and contribute to enabling a full suite of Salesforce applications on Google Cloud. You will get an opportunity to build a platform on GCP to enable agentic solutions on Salesforce.

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Software Security Engineer to join our GCP team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing our security posture across various domains, focusing on development, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, and the security of distributed and scalable distributed systems. This role requires hands-on experience with security systems, a deep understanding of modern threats, and the ability to drive security improvements through engineering solutions.


As a Software Security Engineer, you won’t just find vulnerabilities, you’ll engineer the systems that prevent them. You will play a pivotal role in securing our distributed micro-services architecture on GCP, moving security by building automated, high-performance tools that empower our entire engineering organization.


Your Impact:

  • Security Engineering & Automation: Build and integrate high-performance security tools and custom scripts into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST/DAST, SCA, SIEM) to automate manual toil.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and secure Terraform/IaC templates to ensure our cloud infrastructure is hardened by design before it ever reaches production.

  • Vulnerability Leadership: Lead the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle, using a risk-based approach to prioritize remediation across network, cloud, and application layers.

  • Architecture & Threat Modeling: Partner with DevOps and Product teams to conduct threat modeling and architectural reviews, ensuring new features are resilient and scalable.

  • Compliance & Governance: Act as the technical lead for audits (SOC2, ISO 27001), leveraging automation to provide evidence of consistent monitoring and timely closure of risks.

  • Production Resilience: Troubleshooting and resolving complex security issues in production using distributed tracing and modern monitoring tools.


Required Skills:

  • Engineering Mindset: 2+ years of experience for MTS, 5+ years for SMTS, in Security Engineering with a focus on building tools, not just managing them.

  • Coding Proficiency: Strong experience in Go, Java, or Python with a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and automation.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise: Deep experience with GCP (similar) and Terraform for managing cloud security posture (CSPM) and infrastructure.

  • Security Domain Knowledge: Practical experience with network protocols, OS hardening (Linux), and modern attack vectors.

  • Collaborative Spirit: A desire to work cross-functionally with DevOps to embed security into the SDLC.


Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience in secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices.

  • Familiarity with container security technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with developing or contributing to open source tools.

title: Salesforce AI Agent Architect（Multiple Levels）
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

顧客のAI活用に伴う業務変革を牽引する技術責任者として、現行業務の分析および可視化を起点とし、自律型AIエージェント「Agentforce」をはじめとするSalesforceのAIソリューションにおける設計、構築から定着化までを担当します。本ポジションの役割は、仕様書に沿ったシステム構築にとどまりません。すでにシステム化された領域だけでなく、手作業や属人的に処理されている領域も含めて顧客の業務全体を分析・可視化し、業務モデルとして体系化することから着手します。そのうえで、どの業務をAIエージェントに配置すれば高い効果が得られるかを見極めて切り出し、設計・構築・検証・本番展開、さらには稼働後の定着化、内製化にいたるまで、責任を持って遂行します。

(1) 業務分析からエージェント構築、本番展開、定着化・内製化支援までの一連の工程への関与

提示された仕様に基づくシステム開発ではなく、業務分析からエージェントの構築、本番展開にいたるまでを一貫して担当します。各フェーズにおける主な特徴は以下の通りです。

  • 業務分析・モデリング：システム化されていない手作業や属人的な領域も含めて現行業務を可視化し、業務モデルとして体系化します。各業務を「定型業務（ルールベース）」「判断業務（推論・確率ベース）」「創造業務（人間主導）」に分類し、AIエージェントに任せることで効果が出る業務を切り出します。
  • プロセス設計（推論・確率ベース × ルールベース）：推論・確率ベース（LLM）が持つ柔軟性と、ルールベースが持つ正確性および統制の双方の適用境界を見極め、処理単位ごとにどちらで構築すべきかを判断します。Agentforceのメインルーチンは推論エンジンとなる一方、確実な実行が必要な部分はAgent Scriptで記述する「ハイブリッド推論」により決定論的に制御します。
  • 設計・開発・テストから本番デプロイ：エージェントおよびサブエージェントの構成、トピック（業務分類）、インストラクション（動作指示）、アクション（Flow、Apex、またはAPIなど）を設計・実装します。評価・テストを通じて誤答や意図しない挙動を防ぎ、CI/CDを用いて安全に本番環境へ移行します。
  • 定着化・内製化支援：本番展開後においても、活用の定着化や新たなユースケースの提案、さらには顧客自身がエージェントを運用・改善できる体制（内製化）の構築までを支援します。これにより、Agentforceが顧客の業務基盤として定着するよう継続的な支援を行います。



(2) Agentforceを起点とした広範なAI・データ基盤への技術領域の拡大

対象となる技術領域はAgentforceに限定されません。Data Cloudによるデータのリアルタイム統合およびグラウンディング、Salesforceプラットフォーム全般、Sales、ServiceまたはMarketingなどの各機能、さらには外部AIサービスや他システムとの連携まで、幅広い製品群を活用してシステムを構築します。ご自身の得意な領域から実務に着手し、プロジェクトでの実践を通じて段階的に対応範囲を拡大することが可能です。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

本ポジションの担当者は、特定の役割に固定されることなく、プロジェクトの各フェーズにおいて必要となる以下の業務を幅広く担当します。

  • (1) 業務分析・モデリング：顧客の現行業務を可視化し、定型業務（ルールベース）、判断業務（推論・確率ベース）、創造業務（人間主導）などに分類したうえで、AIエージェントを適用することで効果が見込める業務領域を見極めます。
  • (2) ユースケース策定：切り出した業務について、AIエージェントの動作方針や適用範囲を定め、推論・確率ベース（LLM）で実行する処理とルールベース（FlowまたはApex）で実行する処理を切り分けます。あわせて、Data Cloudを用いたデータ統合・グラウンディングの方針や、AI Trust Layerによるデータ保護・コンプライアンス（ガードレール）を含むデータとAIの統制方針を策定し、必要に応じてPoCにより効果を早期に検証します。
  • (3) Agentforceの設計・開発：業務範囲に応じたエージェント／サブエージェントの構成、トピック（業務分類）・インストラクション（動作指示）・アクション（Flow、Apex、APIなど）を設計・実装します。Agent Scriptを用いたハイブリッド推論の設計により、判断が必要な部分は推論に委ね、順序遵守や予測可能性が求められる処理は決定論的に制御します。必要に応じて外部エージェントやAPI連携を組み込み、Data CloudによるグラウンディングやAI Trust Layerによる機密データのマスキングなど、データ基盤とセキュリティの設計までを担います。
  • (4) 評価・本番デプロイ・運用：プロンプトやインストラクションの調整を通じてエージェントの誤答や意図しない挙動を防ぐ評価・テストを実施し、変更セットやCI/CDを用いて安全に本番環境へ移行します。稼働後は対話履歴や稼働ログを分析し、タスク完了率や顧客満足度（CSAT）の継続的な改善、および業務分類の見直しを行います。
  • (5) 組織統制（Agent CoE）：社内で複数のAIエージェントが乱立・誤動作することを防ぐため、共通のセキュリティ基準、設計・開発標準、プロセスやツール体制、共有部品を定義・管理する組織（Agent CoE：Center of Excellence）の設立および運営を支援します。あわせて、活用の定着化や新たなユースケースの提案など、Agentforceが顧客の業務インフラとして機能するよう、体制やプロセスを含めて包括的に支援します。



You're Our Person If...

以下の経験やスキル、資質を有していることを想定しています。

  • 業務分析・システム構築の実務経験：ITシステム構築における業務分析・要件定義から、設計、構築、テスト、本番移行にいたる一連の工程について、標準的な開発手法やプロジェクト管理手法に基づき、自ら開発に携わった経験、あるいはプロジェクトを責任を持って推進した実績を有していること。必要な経験年数は入社時のグレードに応じて以下を想定します（Consultant クラス：5年以上、Architect クラス：6年以上、Senior / Director Architect クラス：11年以上）。
  • 「推論・確率ベース × ルールベース」双方への基礎的な理解：推論・確率ベース（LLM）の挙動やプロンプト設計の基本と、従来のプログラムや自動化フロー（ルールベース）が持つ確実性の双方を理解し、これらを課題や要件に応じて適切に使い分けられるスキルを有していること。
  • AI・LLM技術を用いたソリューション構築経験：AIおよびLLM技術を用いたソリューションの構築からデプロイにいたる実践的な工程において、LLMの統合や高度なAIオーケストレーションフレームワークの適用、プロンプトエンジニアリング技術、ならびにエージェントフレームワークを用いた開発に直接携わった実務経験を有していること。
  • 技術領域を広げる主体性：既存の技術や開発手法にとどまらず、AgentforceからData Cloud、外部AIサービスにいたるまで、新たな技術を自ら主体的に習得し、対応範囲を拡張する意欲と実行力があること。
  • 論理的なコミュニケーション力：曖昧な要望や複雑な業務・システム構成を図や言葉を用いて論理的に整理・可視化し、開発チームや顧客との間で円滑に合意を形成できる能力があること。

title: Lead Software Engineer – Identity Platform Services
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for Trailblazer Identity (TBID), a tier-1 B2C identity platform supporting more than 10 million users and 30+ Salesforce digital experiences and partner properties.

This is a highly technical individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep hands-on engineering experience with strong architectural judgment, technical leadership, and the ability to influence across teams.

You will be part of the Platform Services team within Digital Marketing Technology and will provide technical leadership for the services that power Trailblazer Identity.

You will work across multiple engineering teams and partner closely with Product, Architecture, Security, and other technology organizations to design and evolve secure, scalable, highly available identity and platform services.

This role requires someone who can move comfortably between architecture and implementation: defining technical direction, evaluating trade-offs, solving complex engineering problems, mentoring engineers, and remaining close enough to the code to lead by example.

Success in this role requires more than designing strong systems. You will be expected to influence technical decisions across teams, navigate ambiguity and disagreement, drive alignment with stakeholders, and raise the engineering bar for the broader platform.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of large-scale, secure, and resilient backend platform services.
  • Provide technical leadership for services supporting Salesforce’s Trailblazer Identity platform and broader digital ecosystem.
  • Translate ambiguous product and business requirements into clear technical architectures and implementation strategies.
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and clearly articulate trade-offs related to scale, reliability, security, performance, operability, and development velocity.
  • Remain hands-on with engineering and contribute directly to the design, implementation, review, and evolution of production systems.
  • Drive technical decisions and alignment across multiple engineering teams, architects, product partners, and dependent organizations.
  • Lead the design of APIs, distributed systems, data flows, and event-driven architectures supporting high-scale customer-facing experiences.
  • Establish and champion engineering best practices across system design, testing, observability, operational readiness, security, CI/CD, and software quality.

Technical depth required. Architectural judgment expected.

Salesforce is hiring Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — the Technical Builders, responsible for deciding that leads who design, build, and deploy the most complex agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll lead technical delivery on your team, mentor the next wave of engineers, and set the engineering standards that define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale. Partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption), you'll own outcomes end-to-end, from architecture decision to production.   • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.

Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.

  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

  • You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.
  • You've integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.

The Experience

CSGとは、顧客を成功に導くことを最重要ミッションとするカスタマーサクセスグループのことです。事業戦略の観点からは、Salesforceのポストセールス部門にあたり、顧客マネジメント部門やコンサルティング部門、サポート部門やリニューアル部門で構成されています。

このロールの候補者は、CSGのプロフェッショナルサービス部門(コンサルティング部門)のリーダーに対し、リソース管理の観点から戦略的示唆を提示し、定常的な部門運営を推進する「サービス・オペレーションチーム」のシニアアナリストです。リソース管理(国内外のコンサルタントおよび社外パートナ)を通じてビジネスの成長に貢献します。

CSGサービス部門のリーダーにとって信頼に足るアドバイザーとして、ビジネス戦略のビジョンを共有し、顧客の成功や組織の成長に向けた革新的なアプローチを特定します。また、コンサルタントがもたらす成果について、客観的かつデータに基づいた洞察を提示することが求められます。

このロールの成功は、CSGサービス部門のBooking(受注額)、売上、利益率および顧客満足度等によって測られます。戦略的なアウトプットとしては、サービス部門の要員構成を踏まえた戦略的な成長プランの策定や社外パートナーとの協業計画策定、部門パフォーマンスの財務・事業両面での測定や傾向分析、示唆の提示などがあります。

業務上は、サービス部門のコンサルティング・マネージャーと営業担当者の間に立って、案件への最適な人員配置の実現やパートナー選定、海外リソースの調達などを論理的、効率的、かつ強力に推進することが求められます。

候補者は、部門内だけではなくグローバルCSG組織、財務や採用、人事、部門戦略担当者と密接に協業することが求められます。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 中長期戦略の立案・推進：CSGサービス部門の状況を分析し、リソース（要員・スキル）の観点から部門の成長につながる戦略やイニシアチブを積極的に立案・推進する
  • リソース供給能力の最大化：サービス提供能力（デリバリーキャパシティ）を最大化するため、社内コンサルタントの稼働率管理や、海外協業推進、パートナー拡大を行う
  • アサインメントの最適化：リソース調整会議をリードし、コンサルティング・マネージャーや営業担当者と連携しながら、プロジェクトへの最適な人員配置、パートナー選定、海外リソースの調達を推進する
  • グローバル・他部門との連携：日本のCSG全体の方向性や戦略との整合性を図るため、グローバル組織や財務、人事、IT等の各部門と協業し、部門運営プロセス（オペレーション）の継続的な改善を行う
  • メトリクスの定義と可視化：高いレベルのビジネス目標（KPI）に対し、進捗を測定するためのメトリクスを定義し、レポートやダッシュボード（Salesforce等）を用いて可視化・計測する
  • データ駆動型の意思決定支援：ビジネスの進捗やKPIを定期的に分析・報告し、データと客観的な分析に基づいてマネジメント層の迅速な意思決定をサポートする



You're Our Person If...

  • 3〜5年の事業部門運営（Business Operations）、リソースマネジメント、またはそれに準ずる部門管理・オペレーション経験
  • コンサルティングファームやITサービス企業などの「プロフェッショナルサービス・ビジネス」における実務経験、または密接な協業経験
  • プロジェクトマネージャー、営業、財務など、多様なステークホルダーとの高度な交渉・調整能力（コンフリクトマネジメント能力）
  • ビジネスレベルの英語力（グローバルチームとの会議、メール、チャットでの円滑な意思決定・交渉が可能であること）および流暢な日本語力
  • 変化の速い環境（アジャイルな環境）や新しい要求に対して、柔軟かつ適切に対応できる能力
  • 異文化に対する理解、および多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーと協業できるダイバーシティへの高い意識



Even Better If...

  • Salesforce製品の知識・利用経験、または認定資格
  • IT project への参画経験
  • BIツールやダッシュボード（Tableau、Salesforce Reports等）を用いたデータ分析・可視化の実務経験

【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】

株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

  • ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。

descriptionHtml:

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The Strategic Enterprise Account Executive role is part of our Enterprise Sales teams specialized in verticals like Retail & Consumer Goods, Media & Communication, Financial Services or Healthcare & Life Sciences. This team is comprised of elite, forward-thinking sales leaders, industry experts, and strategic visionaries who partner with our most valuable, top-tier clients. Operating in a highly focused model, you will be in charge of a dedicated, select handful of enterprise accounts (or a singular, massive global account) to shape their overarching digital transformation and drive their evolution into an Agentic Enterprise—where autonomous AI agents and humans work together to drive unparalleled success.
 

We are looking for Strategic Account Executives to lead and orchestrate our highest-value enterprise relationships. In this role, you don't just sell software; you act as a trusted advisor to C-level decision-makers, defining multi-year strategic roadmaps and translating complex business challenges into high-value AI and cloud solutions. You will lead a massive virtual matrix team to deliver a unified vision, balancing short-term commercial execution with long-term partnership value.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Success will be measured by your ability to drive annual recurring revenue (ARR), expand our strategic footprint within your assigned accounts, maintain high customer satisfaction, and successfully orchestrate internal matrixed teams to execute a unified account strategy.

  • Drive the Account Vision: Partner closely with co-account executives and stakeholders to define, own, and execute a comprehensive, multi-year strategic roadmap for complex, top-tier accounts.

  • Engage the C-Suite: Act as a trusted advisor to C-level executives. Evangelize AI-powered solutions, platform ecosystems, and digital transformation through strategic, value-based selling and compelling Points of View (POVs).

  • Orchestrate the Matrix: Function as the "Strategic Quarterback" leading a large virtual team. Align Specialist AEs, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Global System Integrators (GSIs) to ensure a seamless, unified customer experience.

  • Deliver Measurable Value: Translate deep industry trends into tangible business cases, ROI analyses, and strategic workshops that empower customers to achieve their global business objectives.

  • Maintain Operational Excellence: Navigate high-pressure environments, manage complex annual quota planning, deliver accurate forecasting, and consistently achieve revenue goals.

You’re Our Person If...

Note on Industry Verticals: We are looking for candidates aligned with one of the following core verticals. Please specify your expertise in your application.

Select Your Aligned Industry Vertical:

  • Retail & Consumer Goods: Deep understanding of the massive shifts in retail, apparel, lifestyle, or fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG). Experience navigating complex global supply chains, direct-to-consumer (DTC) digital transformations, and omni-channel customer experiences.

  • Healthcare & Life Sciences: Deep understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, pharmaceuticals, biotech, or medical devices. Experience navigating complex regulatory environments, patient-centric digital care, and clinical/commercial transformation roadmaps.

  • Financial Services: Deep understanding of banking, capital markets, wealth management, or insurance. Experience dealing with strict compliance frameworks, fintech disruptions, data privacy, and core legacy-to-cloud modernization strategies.

  • Media & Communication: Deep understanding of telecommunications, entertainment, streaming, or digital media networks. Experience with subscriber lifecycle management, content distribution platforms, advertising tech, and next-generation connectivity models.

Core Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in complex, multi-national enterprise SaaS sales, top-tier management consulting, or driving large-scale internal digital transformations within the specified vertical.

  • Executive Presence: Proven ability to convey leadership, direction, and confidence in every interaction, effortlessly adapting your communication style for top-down C-level discussions.

  • Matrix Leadership: Demonstrated success navigating and leading large, cross-functional virtual teams and external partners in a fast-paced environment without formal disciplinary authority.

  • Resilience & Execution: A consistent track record of navigating high-pressure commercial environments, managing complex enterprise deal cycles, and meeting or exceeding high-value revenue quotas.

  • Language Skills: Professional fluency in English and German (both written and spoken) to support our regional and global client bases.

Even Better If...

  • You bring a unique hybrid background (e.g., a mix of top-tier strategy consulting and direct Enterprise SaaS sales execution).

  • You possess deep technical or strategic familiarity with next-generation autonomous AI agents, Customer 360 ecosystems, or advanced CRM platforms.

  • You have established, active relationships with C-level stakeholders within the target vertical across Germany and the broader EMEA region.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time.  You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures  and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. 

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

descriptionHtml:

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Design at Qualified is small and intentional. There's no design systems team or research ops function, just close access to the product, fast feedback loops, and problems that rarely have obvious solutions.

Most of those problems are about AI where the interface is rarely the hard part. The challenge is helping users understand what the AI is doing, trust it when it's right, catch it when it's wrong, and shape it toward what they actually need. That takes judgment more than process.

We're building Piper, an AI SDR that runs autonomous sales conversations, follows up with prospects, and moves pipeline without a human in the loop. Piper is not a chatbot and not a copilot. Piper is an agent. You will work on two of its most interesting surfaces: the AI brain (how Piper understands prospects and explains its reasoning) and conversational presence (the live chat and video experience where the AI is the rep).

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • The first surface is Piper's brain: how Piper understands a lead, forms a plan, and explains its reasoning. You'll design the interface for shaping its personality, goals, and objection handling. Not a settings panel. Something closer to a thinking partner you can tune.
  • The second is Piper's live presence, the chat and video experience where the AI is the rep. The work is in the details: the micro-interactions, latency handling, turn-taking, and tone that make it feel credible instead of uncanny.
  • The design patterns for autonomous agents in enterprise sales are still being figured out. You'll be part of that.

You're Our Person If...

  • 6+ years of product design, with at least 2 years on AI or conversational experiences
  • You understand LLM behavior (latency, streaming, confidence, failure modes) and design for it honestly
  • Fluent in AI tooling as a core part of how you work, not an experiment
  • Strong visual and interaction craft. You have taste.
  • Comfortable without a detailed brief. You define the problem alongside the solution.
  • Works directly with eng and ML. No handoff culture here.

Even Better If...

  • Voice, video, or real-time communication design background
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales or CRM workflows
  • Experience designing multi-step autonomous workflows


How you work

Taste over process. Prototypes over presentations. Speed is a quality, judgment is the craft. You think of yourself as a creative director of AI collaborators, not a solo craftsperson. Concretely:

  • You prototype in code or with AI tools, not just Figma
  • You're faster with agents than most designers are without them
  • You ship design decisions, not just document them


Why Join Qualified

The design patterns for AI agents in enterprise sales are still being established. You'd be one of a few people defining them at production scale, on a product that's already live and growing.

Ownership here is genuine. You'll work directly with leadership, influence product direction, and own your work from problem definition through ship. No gatekeeping, no waiting for a brief.

The Salesforce acquisition puts our work in front of one of the largest enterprise customer bases on the planet. It is important that the team remains nimble and autonomous to keep innovation moving.

The Technical Architect for Tableau Next is an execution-focused analytics architect and primary subject matter expert for the Tableau Next platform. You will design and deliver migrations from Salesforce CRM Analytics, Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, and legacy Tableau Server to a modern data stack. As the primary technical authority for this migration track, you will own the Tableau Next analytics platform architecture, legacy content migration strategy, and feature adoption roadmap.

Operating at the forefront of the modern data stack, you will architect scalable and secure solutions that bridge Data Cloud's foundational architecture with Tableau Next. You will combine deep Analytics, Data 360, and Salesforce knowledge to ensure dashboards, data sources, permissions, and security structures are migrated with full fidelity, improved performance, and accelerated time-to-insight for business users.

You will use approved enterprise AI tools as an authorized input to relevant architecture, migration, analysis, and documentation work. You will validate AI-assisted outputs, test assumptions, protect confidential information, and remain accountable for technical decisions, migration quality, and customer outcomes.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Tableau Next Platform Ownership: Act as the definitive technical authority for Tableau Next, leading the end-to-end transition of dashboards and reporting from Salesforce CRM Analytics, Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, and legacy Tableau Server.
  • AI-Assisted Architecture and Migration: Use approved enterprise AI tools to support architecture documentation, legacy-to-target mappings, migration planning, test-case development, diagnostics, and technical communications. Apply expert judgment to validate outputs and preserve business logic, data fidelity, and platform compatibility.
  • Security and Governance Architecture: Design and implement comprehensive data governance and security frameworks within the new architecture, enforcing policy-based data visibility and row-level security (RLS) to ensure strict, role-aligned data access.
  • Human Accountability and Validation: Review AI-assisted recommendations, mappings, and analysis for accuracy, completeness, security, privacy, and alignment with approved architecture and governance standards before they inform delivery or customer decisions.
  • Data Source Architecture: Architect the data source framework using Analytics, Data 360, and Salesforce knowledge to design live connections and optimized models tailored for Tableau Next.
  • Data Ingestion and Engineering: Own and manage data ingestion directly within Salesforce Data Cloud to power the Tableau Next reporting layer.
  • Semantic Layer Design: Design and build the semantic layer strictly within Salesforce Data Cloud to support all Tableau Next analytical requirements.
  • Model Translation: Map and translate legacy BI semantic models into Data Cloud Calculated Insights and semantic models, using structured validation to confirm business logic equivalence.
  • Data Lineage: Define end-to-end data lineage, ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved when migrating fields through Data Cloud transformation layers.
  • Discovery and Strategy: Lead functional and technical discovery workshops with client teams to assess legacy report complexity, usage analytics, and data source dependencies.
  • Advisory: Serve as a Trusted Advisor to Analytics leaders and Enterprise Architects to shape the Tableau Next migration roadmap, self-service analytics vision, and data governance strategy.
  • Migration Standards: Establish best-in-class standards for the migration practice, building reusable Tableau Next dashboard templates, Data Cloud connection frameworks, migration validation methods, and governance playbooks.
  • Execution and Cutover: Plan and execute cutover strategies, including legacy BI deprecation, user access migration, and post-go-live enablement.
  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and proactively mitigate technical risks related to data source credentials, calculated field logic parity, RLS re-implementation, extract refresh SLAs, data readiness, and AI-assisted migration outputs.
  • Technical Communication: Translate architecture decisions, migration risks, data limitations, and validation findings into clear guidance for client teams, Analytics leaders, and Enterprise Architects.



Experience:

  • Tableau Next: Comprehensive, hands-on mastery of the Tableau Next platform, including advanced dashboarding, platform capabilities, and usage reporting.
  • Salesforce Data Cloud Expertise: Deep technical understanding of data connections, data ingestion, Data Streams, Data Lake Objects (DLOs), Data Model Objects (DMOs), Data Governance, and Calculated Insights.
  • Data Governance and Security: Proven ability to design and execute complex data governance models, specifically implementing policy-based data visibility and row-level security (RLS).
  • Salesforce CRM Analytics: Proven experience and technical depth in CRM Analytics, formerly Einstein Analytics.
  • Semantic Models: Advanced ability to design, build, and migrate semantic layers, specifically within the Salesforce Data Cloud architecture.
  • Salesforce Administrator Knowledge: Deep understanding of Salesforce platform administration, security models, and user management.
  • Salesforce Core Platform: Functional knowledge of at least one Salesforce Cloud, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Financial Services Cloud.
  • AI-Fluent Technical Practice: Demonstrated ability to use approved enterprise AI tools or comparable authorized AI-assisted methods for role-relevant work products such as architecture documentation, migration mappings, test cases, diagnostics, or technical analysis, with human validation and accountability for the final result.



Preferred Experience:

  • Knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud One.
  • Experience migrating from IBM Cognos, SAP Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Microsoft Power BI, Looker, or legacy Tableau Server to Tableau Next.
  • Familiarity with Tableau Site and Governance Architecture, including project hierarchy, permission models, and content certification workflows.
  • Understanding of broader cloud data platform integrations, including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, and Azure Synapse, as secondary analytical sources.
  • Knowledge of dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar orchestration tools for upstream data pipeline dependencies.
  • Familiarity with Tableau Embedded Analytics for migrating legacy embedded BI into external applications.
  • Understanding of Tableau Bridge for on-premises data source connectivity.
  • 10+ years of general experience in Business Intelligence, analytics, and data platform solutions.
  • 5+ years of hands-on analytics development and architecture experience.

    Required Certifications
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator
  • Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant



Highly Desired (Very Strong Plus)

  • Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
  • Tableau Desktop Specialist



Nice to Have

  • Tableau Certified Data Analyst
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced
  • Databricks Certified Associate Developer
  • dbt Analytics Engineering Certification

Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About the Role
Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customization, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, Slack and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.


What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organizations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Design secure authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth, SSO, enterprise identity providers, and API gateways.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.


You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have 3+ years (6-10 years for Senior levels) of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You bring deep hands-on expertise with Slack platform architecture: integrating Slack APIs (Web, Events, Bolt framework), managing complex enterprise authentication flows, and building/extending Slackbot systems as both MCP Clients and Servers.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Slack Certified Developer or experience deploying enterprise-grade Slack apps across multi-workspace (Enterprise Grid) environments
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. You are a builder of trust—with customers, with delivery teams, and with internal partners. You bring credibility through proximity to the work, and you help teams navigate the unique demands of a Public Sector, cleared environment.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Delivery Governance: Own and manage the day-to-day delivery health of assigned engagements, ensuring strict adherence to Salesforce Professional Services Methodology (SPSM) standards, project gates, and outcome-based delivery practices.
  • Project Planning & Control: Create, lead, and review project plans; monitor timelines and dependencies; adjust schedules and plans as needed; track utilization of resources against prioritization and budget.
  • Program & Project Scope: Lead one or two large enterprise projects or multiple small-to-medium interrelated projects requiring complex multi-functional collaboration at the program level.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Monitor project health signals (RYG/PSA Pulses) to proactively identify, track, and resolve project risks before they become issues.
  • Project Recovery: Lead or support project recovery efforts on at-risk engagements; partner with the PDL on escalations that require additional oversight.
  • Methodology & Execution: Adopt a standardized development lifecycle methodology across engagements; oversee end-to-end implementation planning, issue management, risk tracking, and organizational change.
  • Primary Interface: Serve as the primary delivery relationship owner and interface for customer stakeholders at the program management, operational, and executive levels—building trust through consistent communication, transparency, and follow-through.
  • Advisory & Strategy: Establish and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders by providing vision, future product roadmapping, and driving business process improvements.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate client review sessions, requirement-gathering workshops, and status meetings.
  • Escalation & Alignment: Lead difficult conversations regarding scope, budget, timelines, and resourcing; formally document and communicate outcomes while resolving partner concerns.
  • Value Realization: Contribute to value realization conversations by helping customers connect delivery progress to mission outcomes and KPIs.
  • Technical Alignment: Facilitate and guide the creation of technical design documents for complex projects by collaborating directly with Technical Architects and Developers.
  • Quality & Deliverables: Responsible for all project deliverables, reviewing work products prepared by the team prior to submission to the client.

title: Lead, Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience
 
  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures — and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.


What You'll Actually Be Building
 
  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.


You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
 
  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through — ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.


Nice-to-Haves
 
  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

 À propos du poste

Expérience en production requise. Mentalité Builder non négociable.

Salesforce recrute des Forward Deployed Engineers — des Technical Builders expérimentés qui conçoivent, développent et déploient des solutions d'IA agentique directement dans les environnements clients en entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery, en étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder — un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et pilote l'adoption) pour co-construire des solutions mises en production dès le premier jour. Les missions vont d'un grand compte stratégique unique à plusieurs comptes simultanés. Le fil conducteur : du vrai code, de vrais environnements, et un impact business mesurable. Ce travail couvre la configuration, la personnalisation et le déploiement full-stack — en livrant des solutions dont les clients dépendent.

L'expérience Builder
 
  • Développement assisté par l'IA : Livrez de vraies solutions clients, avec les meilleurs outils IA du marché — Cursor, Claude, et les produits Salesforce comme Vibes — intégrés à votre quotidien.
  • Delivery collaboratif : Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Senior Forward Deployed Engineers et d'un Deployment Strategist. Vous serez responsable de composants concrets, bénéficierez d'un mentorat structuré de personnes ayant déjà livré des systèmes agentiques à grande échelle, avec une trajectoire claire vers la conduite de projets complexes.
  • Accès à la frontière technologique : Notre plateforme d'IA agentique évolue en temps réel. Vous travaillerez sur des capacités que la plupart des ingénieurs n'aborderont pas avant des mois — couvrant Agentforce, la data, la plateforme et les architectures headless — et vos insights terrain alimenteront directement les équipes produit qui les développent.
  • Innovation continue : Vous devrez rester à la pointe, en expérimentant de nouveaux outils IA, modèles et frameworks, et en partageant vos apprentissages avec votre équipe et vos clients.


Ce que vous allez concrètement construire
 
  • Développer des agents IA et des expériences qui réalisent de vraies actions pour de vraies organisations. Nos solutions sont en production chez certaines des plus grandes entreprises mondiales. Ce travail a du sens parce que les clients en dépendent.
  • Concevoir l'intelligence des agents : prompts, raisonnement, appels d'outils et intégration avec les systèmes clients, en s'appuyant sur notre plateforme d'IA agentique et les techniques LLM actuelles.
  • Prendre en charge des composants techniques de bout en bout : du choix d'architecture jusqu'au déploiement, validé et observable en production.
  • Construire et intégrer des pipelines de données sur Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks et les plateformes de données clients. Modéliser la donnée, livrer le pipeline, valider les outputs.
  • Développer et maintenir des dashboards de performance des agents et des reportings KPI clients pour suivre la santé des déploiements et les résultats business.
  • Contribuer à des preuves de concept et des MVP qui passent de l'esquisse au déployable en jours, pas en mois.
  • Co-construire aux côtés des clients et partenaires, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en les montant en compétences au fil des missions. Laisser les équipes plus capables après chaque engagement qu'avant.
  • Remonter les lacunes de la plateforme, cas limites et insights terrain aux ingénieurs seniors et à l'équipe produit. Votre expérience terrain est la boucle de feedback produit.
  • Travailler en binôme avec le Deployment Strategist de votre pod pour traduire les enjeux business clients en solutions agentiques qui livrent vraiment.


Vous êtes notre Forward Deployed Engineer si…
 
  • Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou en delivery technique, avec au moins un système en production dont vous seriez fier de nous parler — idéalement dans une stack IA, du développement full-stack, ou avec des modèles frontier.
  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Vous avez une expérience préalable en delivery technique orienté client (conseil, services professionnels ou forward deployed engineering) — c'est une exigence, pas un bonus.
  • Vous maîtrisez au moins un langage parmi Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Apex — et êtes prêt à en ajouter d'autres selon les besoins.
  • Vous avez une expérience pratique des LLMs et du prompt engineering. Vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi un prompt a échoué et ce que vous changeriez.
  • Vous comprenez la modélisation de données, les APIs et les patterns d'intégration suffisamment en profondeur pour les concevoir, pas seulement les consommer.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans une salle avec des équipes commerciales et des architectes clients.
  • Vous livrez du code de qualité et évaluez les outputs IA avec la rigueur d'un ingénieur.
  • Vous explorez activement le paysage IA/data en évolution — en testant de nouveaux outils, en expérimentant de nouveaux modèles, et en restant sincèrement curieux de ce qui arrive.
  • Vous vous épanouissez dans le groupe de travail qui construit quelque chose, pas seulement qui en parle.
  • Vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée de voyager ~25% du temps pour travailler directement aux côtés des clients.


Atouts supplémentaires
 
  • Expérience sur la plateforme Salesforce ou certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarité avec les frameworks d'agents (LangChain, LlamaIndex) et les patterns d'orchestration
  • Expérience pratique des plateformes de données cloud (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Expérience dans des domaines IA spécialisés : data engineering, architecture plateforme ou déploiements headless

title: Business Development Director, Marketplace
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Role Purpose & Ecosystem Context

As an elite, high-touch commercial overlay and marketplace specialist driving the transactional evolution of the Salesforce ISV ecosystem, the Principal Marketplace Business Development Manager sits at the direct intersection of Revenue, Strategy, and Partner Operations. This role is responsible for marketplace GMV velocity, owning the adoption of evolved marketplace functionality to deliver meaningful incremental ACV growth and accelerating overall GTM automation and transformation.

Convincing established enterprise partners to commit their core products, services and revenue streams to a nascent marketplace is an exceptionally difficult, deeply sophisticated sales pitch. This role is not a traditional partner management function; it is a senior, strategic co-selling position.

Furthermore, as the GTM App evolves, this individual will architect a brand-new commercial capability for Salesforce: building the end-to-end framework that allows partners to list and transact their entire solutions—comprising both software products and attached professional/managed services—directly with customers. This role will be responsible for driving  incremental revenue through Salesforce’s transactable partners, customers and sellers.

Core Responsibilities & Deliverables

1. High-Touch Marketplace Co-Selling & Deal Architecture

  • Elite Partner Overlay: Act as the specialized marketplace execution expert, stepping into high-stakes, complex partner engagements alongside the AgentExchange GTM Transformation team to deliver the marketplace value proposition and secure structural commitments.

  • Enforce Marketplace Routing Discipline: Maintain strict ownership over the transaction pipeline, stepping into active enterprise deals to unblock multi-party commercial structures and accelerate deal velocity.

  • Custom Commercial Design: Define custom deal mechanics, private offer frameworks, and flexible pricing models, partnering directly with Strategy, Legal, RevOps, and Deal Desk to ensure the field is completely unblocked and ready to transact.

2. Partner Revenue Transformation & Advisory

  • C-Suite Business Advisory: Act as a trusted strategic consultant to partner C-suites (CEOs, CFOs, CROs), guiding them through the intense revenue model, billing infrastructure, and internal sales compensation transformations required to successfully shift to a marketplace-first business model.

  • Change Management Execution: Treat the roll-out of the GTM App as a profound change management program rather than a simple feature launch, directly addressing partner friction regarding margin preservation and field sales alignment.

3. Feedback Loops & AI-First Operational Governance

  • Structured Product Advocacy: Act as the strategic feedback loop between strategic partners and the Product organization. Collect and prioritize input on missing features (especially regarding services monetization), building data-driven business cases that separate true roadmap priorities from one-off requests.

  • AI-First Infrastructure: Own the pipeline tracking, KPIs, reporting, and roadmap reviews for this motion. Ensure all internal workflows and program management strategies are AI-first by default, leveraging automation to maximize ecosystem scale.

4. Supporting the "Products + Services" GTM Motion (0-to-1 Blueprint)

  • Collaborate on the Complete Solution Motion: Work as part of the team responsible for designing, building, and institutionalizing the net-new commercial playbooks that allow partners to package and sell multi-element offers (core software subscriptions bundled with professional, advisory, implementation, or managed services) via the GTM App.

  • Operational Framework Definition: Work cross-functionally to establish the baseline mechanics for how services procurement, milestone tracking, and complex billing allocations are structured and approved within the marketplace ecosystem.

  • Execute Lighthouse Pilots: Identify, target, and sign tier-1 anchor partners to pilot the bundled software-and-services model, capturing deep operational learnings to build a scalable, repeatable playbook for the broader Global Partnerships team.

Key Performance Indicators (Success Metrics)

  • Marketplace GMV & ACV: Direct, shared accountability for achieving the $5M ISV revenue target.

  • Partner Activation Velocity: Ensure the successful adoption and operational change management to ensure partners are prepared to sell through the marketplace.

  • Bundled Solution Launch: Successful transactional execution of the first enterprise-grade "Software + Services" bundled listing pilot with a major global partner.

  • Sales Velocity: Achieve a measurable, documented reduction in "Time-to-Contract" for complex marketplace transactions.

  • Ecosystem Activation: Build and execute comprehensive enablement plans across partner account managers, partners, field sales teams, and end customers. Track and report on readiness milestones to ensure seamless support and execution for marketplace deals..

Candidate Profile & Experience Requirements

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Experience

You will be a Senior Manager of Software Engineering leading a team of 8 to 10 engineers. Your team builds the “Anomaly Alerting” platform. This is a smart system that watches for strange changes in data and sends out warnings. Your job is to guide the people, own the system, and help make our warning alerts smarter and more automatic.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Day-to-day work: You will make sure our alerting system is fast, strong, and does not break as it grows. You will lead projects that make the system do the hard work so other teams don’t have to set up alerts by hand.
  • Leading the way: You will manage 1 to 2 teams (8 to 10 engineers). You will build a happy, helpful culture where people work well together.
  • Working together: You will partner with other tech teams and groups across Salesforce (like Slack and Sales Cloud) so they can find and fix problems much faster. You will also speak for your team in meetings and work closely with our teams in the US.
  • Early goals & impact: In your first 60 to 90 days, you will learn the ropes, start leading in meetings, team up with the US groups, and make a real difference on our biggest goals.



You’re Our Person If...

  • You have experience being a manager and leading 8 to 10 software engineers.
  • You know how to handle huge amounts of data and build data pipelines (ETL).
  • You have experience running systems on big clouds like AWS or Google Cloud (GCP).
  • You have worked with tools that monitor system health (Observability).
  • You have some experience with Machine Learning and know how to spot strange patterns in data (Anomaly Detection).
  • You are able to work in the office as the company requires (no travel is required for this role).



Even Better If...

  • You have deep, hands-on experience building Machine Learning tools that send out alerts.
  • You already know how to work with Salesforce products like Agentforce, Commerce Cloud, or Slack.



Tech Stack:

  • Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments.
  • Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing.
  • Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines.

The Experience
The Messaging Platform team is at the heart of how Salesforce connects with millions of customers and prospects today. We're building an intelligent, agentic platform that powers and prioritizes 1:1 messaging at global scale for Salesforce's own Marketing team. As the internal "customer zero," we partner closely with marketing, core products, and data teams to deliver always-on, always-optimizing communications that drive growth, engagement, and trust. Our charter includes replatforming, enabling advanced targeting and personalization, and streamlining content orchestration across channels — not only laying the foundation for the next generation of messaging experiences, but building them.

The key focus for this role is to lead the design and launch of a new Campaign Brief Agent an AI-powered agent that transforms how marketers initiate and plan campaigns. This agent's core job is to produce the campaign design brief and bill of materials (BOM) defining audience, content, and journey requirements which serves as the structured input to a downstream orchestration layer that delegates to specialized agents. These agents will help transform our marketing team from hands-off keyboard to hands-on, enabling them to design, build, and launch highly engaging and targeted campaigns driving pipeline growth and revenue for Salesforce. As a Director of Product Management, you will strategize, design, build, and execute against a roadmap that you define with your engineering, data scientist, architecture, user experience, and marketing partners. This is a fast-moving area with significant visibility within the organization — we are looking for someone up to the challenge of delivering next generation marketing tools for one of the most agentic-forward enterprises in the world.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Define the vision and roadmap for the Campaign Brief Agent that orchestrates and delegates to specialized agents built for specific jobs to be done in the campaign design process
  • Translate business goals (e.g., retention vs. awareness) into agent interaction models and subscriber-centric campaign strategies in partnership with marketing, engineering, data science, and compliance
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle: from ideation and technical scoping to launch and continuous iteration, including the interaction and delegation model between the Campaign Brief Agent and all downstream agents
  • Define standards for agent performance, reliability, safety, and guardrails — ensuring the system consistently produces high-quality, brand-safe, and effective campaign assets
  • Conduct in-depth customer interviews, analyze campaign performance data, and monitor the competitive landscape to identify pain points and unmet needs in the marketing campaign creation process
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to develop systems that consider engagement history, fatigue, inferred intent, journey state, and suppression rules
  • Develop explainability features that log and articulate agent handoffs, enabling transparency and trust across internal stakeholders
  • Measure performance of the agent using engagement lift, system accuracy, marketer confidence, and business outcomes
  • Act as a thought partner to internal stakeholders, helping them shift from hands-off marketers to hands-on-keyboard marketers
  • Evangelize the platform vision, gain alignment across teams, and drive adoption across all outbound messaging use cases

You're Our Person If...

  • Product Management Expertise:8+ years of experience owning end-to-end product development in complex, data-driven systems — ideally in messaging, marketing tech, or personalization platforms
  • Systems Thinking: ability to design and reason about multi-agent architectures, orchestration models, and delegation logic at scale
  • Data Fluency: strong understanding of behavioral data, engagement signals, fatigue models, and targeting logic; comfortable working with data scientists and interpreting model outputs
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: deep empathy for the end recipient of messages and for the internal teams (marketers, compliance, operations) who rely on your platform
  • Execution Leadership: proven ability to drive projects from concept through launch with cross-functional teams including engineering, data science, compliance, and marketing
  • Communication & Influence: excellent written and verbal communication skills; impressive presentation skills and experience influencing audiences across levels and functions
  • Prioritization & Tradeoffs: skilled at balancing business objectives, subscriber experience, and technical feasibility in high-stakes environments
  • Experience with Messaging Systems (nice to have): familiarity with journey orchestration tools, messaging APIs, campaign management, or customer engagement platforms

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist  in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

Salesforce's Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) provides 24x7x365 security monitoring and rapid incident response across every Salesforce environment, protecting company and customer data from adversaries.

As a Senior Incident Responder, you'll be a core member of the response team — investigating and handling security incidents end to end, taking a lead role on many of them, and escalating to Lead Incident Responders on the most severe or ambiguous events. You'll also help improve the playbooks, detections, and automation that make the team faster, and mentor newer analysts as you grow toward a lead role yourself.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on the detailed work of incident response.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
 
  • Investigate and respond to security incidents end to end — triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review — taking point on many incidents and supporting Lead Incident Responders on the highest-severity, highest-visibility events.
  • Investigate adversary activity, insider threats, and web application attacks across on-premises and multi-cloud environments.
  • Contribute to process improvements, playbooks, and automation — including Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) tooling and detection-as-code — that reduce time-to-detect and time-to-respond, and support strategic projects expanding detection and response capabilities.
  • Produce clear incident documentation and status updates for technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentor newer incident responders, and support the team's on-call rotation (core hours 10:30 AM–6:30 PM ET, Monday–Friday, with occasional overnight/weekend on-call as needed).


You're Our Person If...
 
  • You have 5+ years in information security, including hands-on operational security monitoring and incident response.
  • You can perform host and network forensics across Windows, macOS, and Linux — analyzing file system, memory, process, and network artifacts for indicators of compromise — and have responded to incidents in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including familiarity with cloud architectures, CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery) pipelines, and cloud logging/telemetry.
  • You've handled high-priority incidents, including insider investigations, adversary activity, and web application attacks, and have a solid, current understanding of the threat landscape — attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), tooling, and hardening best practices — including working knowledge of a framework such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, document incidents effectively, and build trusted relationships with peers inside and outside your team.

  • You have prior experience in a 24x7x365 security operations environment, and have improved team capability through automation and tool development.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Data 360
descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life.
