Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About the Role

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

 Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it. 

What You'll Do

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.

  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).

  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.

  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.

  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.

  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.

  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.

  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.

  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.

  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.

  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.

  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.

  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

You're Our Data 360 Forward Deployed Engineer If...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.

  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.

  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.

  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.

  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.

  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.

  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.

  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.

  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.

  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.

  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.

  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.

  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Slack & The Role

Slack is at an inflection point. We're evolving from the world's most beloved team communication tool into something fundamentally new: an AI operating system where humans and agents work together to get things done. This isn't incremental improvement. It's a reimagining of how work happens.

As Slack VP, Product Design (Individual Contributor; Principal Architect) you will be one of the most important design voices shaping that future. This is not a management role. It's a rare seat at the table for a designer who wants to define the product; to hold the vision, drive the craft, and personally execute at the highest level on the next generation of Slack.

You will report to the SVP & Chief Design Officer and partner deeply with product and engineering leadership to prototype, pressure-test, and shape the platform Slack must become. You'll make work that millions of people use every day and you'll help us make the hardest design problems look inevitable in hindsight.

The Opportunity: Designing Slack as the AI Operating System for Action

Slack's defining role in this next era is as the context layer for work: the intelligent interface where humans and AI agents collaborate fluidly to drive outcomes. Built on context, Slack becomes the single, personalized command center that replaces fragmented apps, inboxes, and point solutions.

As Slack VP, Product Design (Individual Contributor; Principal Architect) you will be the designer helping us answer the hardest questions at the frontier of this transformation:

  • Human-Agent Collaboration: What are the right interaction models for a world where AI agents are co-workers? How do agents present information, take action, and hand back control in ways that feel natural, not jarring?
  • Radical Simplification: How do we strip Slack down to its most essential, powerful form while making it capable of far more? How do we absorb complexity so users never have to feel it?
  • Dynamic & Ambient Interfaces: How do we design surfaces that appear when and where decisions need to be made (across voice, mobile, wearables, and desktop) rather than requiring users to navigate to them?
  • The AI Operating System: What does it look like when Slack becomes the single pane of glass for every kind of worker: the CEO, the service agent, the developer, the sales rep? How do we make that feel personal and not overwhelming?

Key Responsibilities

  • Vision & Concept Design: Define and prototype the long-range design vision for Slack's agentic future, producing the seminal concepts and vignettes that align the organization and inspire the roadmap
  • Executional Craft: Personal, hands-on design at the highest level, pixel-perfect, conceptually sharp, deeply considered. Uses whatever tools work best (AI, code, and emerging prototyping techniques) to turn ideas into working experiences fast, explore possibilities, and raise the bar. The bar you set becomes the bar for the team.
  • Strategic Design Influence: Partner with the CDO, CPO, and Engineering leadership to shape product strategy through design. Influence decisions at the SVP and C-level through the power of your work and your thinking
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Drive alignment across product, engineering, research, and brand through the quality and clarity of your design work, without needing formal authority
  • Simplification as a Design Discipline: Lead the work to radically simplify Slack's current experience, defining what we kill, what we keep, and what we transform as we move toward an AI-first paradigm
  • Emerging Interaction Patterns: Invent new design patterns for agentic UX, for voice-anchored experiences, ambient AI surfaces, multiplayer human-agent co-creation, and dynamic UI generation
  • User Advocacy at Scale: Be a relentless champion for the user, particularly the enterprise user under pressure; the worker with 500 unread messages, zero configuration tolerance, and no time to learn a new paradigm

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of product design experience, with senior IC work at significant scale
  • A portfolio that demonstrates both visionary concept work and exceptional executional craft
  • Proven ability to define product direction through design, not just respond to it
  • Experience designing consumer-grade experiences, deeply intuitive, delightful, effortless, in complex product contexts
  • A track record of influencing product strategy at the leadership level without relying on hierarchy
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills; can make complex ideas simple and make simple ideas compelling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for AI, machine learning, or human-agent collaboration. Ideally at the interaction pattern level, not just the UI level
  • Experience with enterprise software and the unique constraints of B2B SaaS at scale
  • Familiarity with emerging modalities: voice UX, ambient/wearable surfaces, AI-generated UI
  • Experience working directly with C-suite leadership to define and evolve product vision
  • Understanding of Slack, its ecosystem, and what makes it uniquely powerful; and what needs to change

What Makes This Role Different

Most senior IC design roles ask you to execute within a defined vision. This one asks you to be the vision while still doing the work. You'll have the strategic altitude of a leadership role and the craft latitude of a builder role. You'll ship things that change how millions of people experience their working lives.

If you've ever looked at a product you love and thought "I could take this somewhere no one's been yet"...this is that role.

descriptionHtml:

About Salesforce

Software Engineer (MTS / SMTS / LMTS), AI Runtime Platform


The role

Build the inference platform behind Salesforce’s AI agents.

Behind every Salesforce AI agent is a model, and behind every model is infrastructure that has to be fast, cheap, and secure. We’re building the Kubernetes-based platform that serves those models: a large and fast-growing fleet of custom models handling massive volumes of LLM traffic across multiple public clouds. You’ll join the Hyperforce Container Platform (HCP) team and build the layer beneath the models: GPU scheduling, distributed inference, and model serving.

This role is for engineers who want their code in the serving path of nearly every agentic request. You’ll work in the open-source ecosystem that the AI industry runs on, and make it production-grade for enterprise requirements: reliability, security, and strict tenant isolation.

What you’ll do

  • Build the inference platform. Design and build core capabilities on Kubernetes: GPU scheduling, distributed model serving, and intelligent request routing.
  • Scale the LLM runtime. Support both inference and training with high-throughput serving and distributed multi-GPU execution.
  • Make shared GPUs a multi-tenant service. Drive inference performance and cost efficiency at fleet scale, with strong tenant isolation.
  • Treat AI as a first-class workload. Secure and operate it on the same service mesh, workload identity, and caching layer as every other Salesforce service.
  • Build the agentic runtime layer. Work on multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, and evaluation for accuracy and safety.
  • Isolate untrusted workloads. Build sandboxing for AI agents and the code they generate, keeping production workloads separated from each other.
  • Own reliability end to end. Run services to a 99.99% availability SLA, and make the platform observable and self-healing at fleet scale.
  • Shape the open-source foundations. Contribute upstream to vLLM, llm-d, Ray, and Kueue, Agent Substrate, and influence their direction and roadmaps.

You’re a great fit if you

  • Have strong software engineering experience, with hands-on depth in distributed systems and production service ownership
  • Have proven experience developing with AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot): you know how to direct them, review their output critically, and ship reliable code with them in your daily workflow
  • Know Kubernetes well and have built controllers or operators using Go. Istio/Envoy  mesh experience is a plus.
  • Have built or operated services on a major public cloud (AWS or GCP)
  • Have worked with managed AI platforms for training and inference, such as AWS SageMaker or Google Vertex AI
  • Write Go fluently
  • Have worked on AI/ML model serving, model training or agentic systems, and can reason about the architecture, cost, and quality of what you build
  • Treat reliability as a design principle: observability, SLOs, and self-healing are built in from the start
  • Hold a degree in a related technical field

Even better if you

  • Have used inference and orchestration stacks such as vLLM, llm-d, Ray, or Kueue
  • Have hands-on experience with GPU scheduling, CUDA, or inference performance tuning
  • Know networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS termination
  • Have used Terraform and Argo, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or Elasticsearch
  • Have built multi-agent or RAG systems, or worked with knowledge graphs and LLM-as-judge evaluation
  • Have contributed to open-source projects upstream

The Experience

カスタマーサクセス・マネージャー（CSM）は、深いビジネス・業界・製品知識を武器に、Signatureサポートプランをご契約中の顧客と伴走するポジションです。特定の事業部門（LoB）、クラウド、または業界に特化することで顧客と同じ視点・言葉を持ち、経営層から現場まで強固な信頼関係を築きながら、Salesforce製品を通じた価値実現（バリュー実現）と投資対効果（ROI）の最大化を牽引します。市場セグメントや企業規模、ソリューションの複雑さが異なる多様な顧客のデジタルジャーニーを直接サポートし、理想的なパートナーとして価値をもたらす役割を担います。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 戦略的伴走とロードマップ策定:顧客のビジネス・技術目標をヒアリングし、現状分析から目標達成を加速する「導入パス(アダプション・パス)」やイネーブルメント計画を策定・実行する。顧客と共にロードマップを作成し、四半期ごとにQBR(Quarterly Business Review)を実施する。
  • 製品活用とガバナンス推進:Salesforce全クラウド・製品群(Sales、Service、Slack、Tableau等)の機能を駆使して活用を推進し、組織戦略・ガバナンス・変更管理(チェンジマネジメント)のベストプラクティスを指導する。
  • プロジェクトのオーケストレーションとリスク管理:顧客の期待値に応じた支援プランを立案・推進し、社内リソース(SA、アーキテクト、営業等)を適宜アサイン・連携させる。目的達成に対するリスクを早期に察知し、アカウントチームと協力して軽減策を講じる。
  • エグゼクティブ・コミュニケーション:CIO、CTO、ビジネス役員などの経営層・意思決定者とエグゼクティブレベルの関係を築き、安定稼動やビジネス効果創出をリードする。技術的な製品変更、障害、サポート終了(EOL)などのアップデートを能動的に伝達する。



You're Our Person If...

  • ビジネスコンサルティング、カスタマーサクセスマネージャー、テクニカルアカウントマネジメントなどのバックグラウンドをお持ちの方(特にBtoC・営業領域での経験)
  • 技術製品の説明が可能な知識レベルをお持ちの方
  • 顧客経営層とのスムーズなコミュニケーション能力をお持ちの方
  • 日本語が流暢な方
  • 社内外のメンバーを巻き込みながら、全体をオーケストレーションするリーダーシップスキルをお持ちの方



Even Better If...

  • 特定の業界、事業部門(LoB)、またはクラウドにおける深い専門知識をお持ちの方
  • 信頼できるアドバイザー(Trusted Advisor)として顧客のビジネス価値向上を牽引した確かな実績をお持ちの方
  • Cレベル(経営層)との効果的な対話力、困難な議論のファシリテーション力、異議申し立てへの柔軟な対応力をお持ちの方
  • Salesforceの製品・プラットフォーム機能、およびガバナンス・エンタープライズアーキテクチャへの深い理解をお持ちの方
  • 技術的・ビジネス的概念を素早く把握し、明確に説明できる方
  • 基本的な英語の読解力をお持ちの方

【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】


株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。
弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

【働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】


ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。

This role builds strong relationships from executive leadership to the front line, driving value realization through Salesforce products and maximizing return on investment (ROI).

Build a roadmap together with the customer and conduct quarterly QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews).

The Experience

Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building a product that learns from human demonstrations and turns complex workflows into repeatable automation across enterprise applications.

Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?

You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. You’ll own substantial systems from design through deployment and help take a new offering from early customer adoption through general availability, backed by Salesforce’s scale and reach.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Drive Agent Development & Architecture

  • Build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.

  • Develop recovery and verification capabilities so agents can adapt to changes, confirm outcomes, and recognize when human intervention is needed.

  • Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.

  • Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers

  • Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.

  • Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.

  • Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.

  • Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

Shape Technical Direction & Grow the Team

  • Own technical decisions for substantial components, from initial design through production operation.

  • Evaluate model selection, tool use, and context management against reliability, latency, and cost.

  • Mentor peers through design discussions and code reviews, and participate in hiring.

You're Our Person If...

  • You’ve independently owned a substantial backend service or system through design, deployment, production failures, and subsequent improvements.

  • You have hands-on experience building and evaluating LLM-powered systems, and can explain how you assessed their quality and failure modes.

  • You can reason through concurrency, persistent state, retries, and partial failures in systems that perform consequential actions.

  • You’re proficient in Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • You can turn an unclear customer problem into a bounded technical approach, test it with users, and carry it through to production.

  • You want direct customer engagement to be part of your engineering work, including investigating problems and discussing technical tradeoffs.

  • You use AI development tools thoughtfully and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of what you ship.

Helpful Experience

  • Agent tool use, code generation, automated recovery, or evaluation frameworks.

  • Browser automation, workflow orchestration, or enterprise integrations.

Turning "what ifs" into something people can feel and react to with tangible experiences in their hand.

  • Acting as a skill multiplier for the broader design org. Conducting training and documenting agentic prototyping workflows so designers themselves can prototype directly in mobile codebases, not just hand off static specs.
  • Partnering with designers and engineers across the org to inject technical and craft expertise wherever it's needed most. Coming to provide direct solutions for various team's current work, or providing creative / technical guidance around native solutions or custom approaches



You're Our Person If...

The Forward Deployed Consultant owns a customer engagement end to end: from the executive business case, through rapid design and deployment of automated process solutions (“Blueprints”) on the Agentforce platform, to a clean handoff to partners and client teams. You will advise enterprise leaders, quantify ROI, and map multi-year automation roadmaps. You bring domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes, including where people patch over system gaps. You will also roll up your sleeves to build, test, and iterate Blueprints with AI agents and prompting tools, proving value fast in live production. You are customer-obsessed, strategic, and execution-focused, with the speed and quality to turn fragmented manual workflows into scalable, value-driven solutions.


Responsibilities

Strategic advisory and business case

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor to enterprise stakeholders, building a deep understanding of business goals and operational pain points.
  • Build business cases and define success criteria up front: KPIs such as cycle time and cost per transaction, with a measured baseline.
  • Own multi-year roadmaps for process Blueprints and automation, balancing strategic direction with near-term execution.
  • Present to executives in terms of their priorities; flag when work is off track early and plainly, with a fix, and drive to a decision.

Blueprint design and rapid value proof

  • Lead structured discovery (workshops, process maps) and turn it into a solution design and a first working version in days to weeks.
  • Automate business processes end to end (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, supplier onboarding), deciding what stays in the ERP, what is automated around it, and what AI decides versus people.
  • Build hands-on with AI agents and prompting tools: design prompts, structure outputs with schemas and examples, and debug and iterate when they fail.
  • Identify integration points with core systems (REST, event-based), managing risks such as auth, latency, payload limits, and retries.

Specification and delivery

  • Translate strategic goals into clear PRDs and technical acceptance criteria.
  • Deliver in continuous build loops (design, build, validate, refine), where each loop proves value and expands scope toward AI-first operations.
  • Lead an AI-first delivery experience, using AI agents and skills to accelerate requirements, build, testing, and documentation.
  • Own delivery end to end through go-live: scoping, build, UAT, data migration, and cutover, managing scope change along the way.
  • Cut scope to the highest-value slice(Day 1 Scope/MVP)) when needed to get live, and justify the trade-off to the customer.

Ownership transfer to customer or partner

  • Design and run handoff processes, documentation, and enablement that transition ownership to implementation partners and customer teams.
  • Set handoff guidelines, solution architecture documentation, and success criteria for sustained post-deployment success.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years in Solutions Consulting, Forward Deployed roles, Strategic or Management Consulting, Product Management, Process Automation, or Business Analysis.
  • Domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, AP/AR, supplier onboarding), including where people patch over system gaps.
  • Hands-on experience building AI or agent-based automation yourself, including prompt design, output structuring, and iterating on failures.
  • Experience engaging enterprise executives in B2B SaaS to build business cases and long-term roadmaps.
  • Proven track record owning engagements from discovery through go-live (UAT, data migration, cutover), not just POCs, followed by structured handoffs.
  • Strong grounding in workflow mapping, process modeling, process improvement, and change management.
  • Experience translating business requirements into automated workflows, PRDs, and user stories.
  • Working knowledge of integration patterns (REST, SOAP, event-based) and common risks such as auth, latency, and payload limits.
  • Track record of setting success KPIs and baselines up front and measuring outcomes after go-live.
  • Executive presence: confident with skeptical executives and willing to deliver bad news early, with a plan.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with the Salesforce platform ecosystem (APIs, platform services).
  • Track record building or navigating partner ecosystems and implementation channels.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or related process improvement certification.
  • Technical or business degree; MBA a plus.

Success metrics

  • Time to first working version: days to weeks from discovery, not months.
  • Go-live rate: share of engagements that reach production, not just a POC.
  • Measured value against baseline: KPI movement after go-live (such as cycle time or cost per transaction) compared with the baseline set up front.

migration waves. Working under the direction of the Technical Architect and Solution Architect, the STC owns

dashboards and Salesforce Flow automations for subscriber count reconciliation, data extension record
validation and consent flag verification.
● Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating migration dry runs against SIT/UAT environments,
capturing reconciliation counts, logging validation failures and iterating until dry run success criteria are
met.

records, private domain configuration, reply mail management and IP warm-up scheduling as directed by

quality thresholds.

loads, activating journeys, validating data extension record counts and confirming suppression lists are
active.

sheets, AMPscript library documentation and journey flow diagrams for client team handover post go-
live.
● Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC deliverables for quality, explaining MCN platform
patterns, unblocking technical issues and providing feedback aligned to factory standards.
● Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating reusable MCN
configuration templates, AMPscript snippet libraries, data migration scripts and validation toolkits in the
shared accelerator repository.

CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS — MUST HAVE
● Marketing Cloud Next — Hands-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Email Studio, Journey
Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder and Contact Builder end-to-end, including sending domain
configuration, journey entry sources, decision splits and triggered sends.
● AMPscript & SSJS Development: Proficiency in AMPscript and SSJS for dynamic email personalisation
— lookup functions, conditional content, row sets, attribute rendering and legacy personalisation logic
recreation.
● Subscriber Data Migration Execution: Hands-on experience executing subscriber data migrations —
data extension population, bulk data loading via Import Wizard and API, suppression list management,
consent record migration and reconciliation validation at scale.
● Salesforce Data Cloud — Configuration: Working knowledge of Data Cloud data stream setup,
DLO/DMO schema configuration, field mapping and data ingestion validation.
● ETL Tools & Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica Cloud, Talend, Azure
Data Factory, MuleSoft) or scripted Bulk API / REST API approaches for subscriber data extraction,
transformation and loading.
● Apex & Platform Development: Ability to write Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, REST callout handlers
and Apex test classes for migration utility development, including subscriber reconciliation tools and
consent flag verification.
● Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, subscriber
count trackers and Salesforce Flow automations as internal factory tooling.
● CI/CD & Source Control: Comfortable working within Salesforce DX and Git-based workflows —
committing changes, following branching conventions, submitting PRs and using Gearset/Copado for
environment promotion.

PREFERRED SKILLS — GOOD TO HAVE
● Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud
Next
● Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) for cross-channel reporting post-migration
● Experience with WhatsApp, Push, SMS or LINE channel configuration in Marketing Cloud Next

● Familiarity with Marketing Cloud REST and SOAP API for programmatic data operations and triggered
sends
● Understanding of IP warm-up strategy and email deliverability monitoring tools (250ok, Validity/Return
Path)
● Exposure to Agentforce journeys triggered from Data Cloud activation segments

● 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Marketing Cloud Next configuration experience
● Experience executing at least 1 end-to-end Marketing Cloud migration or large implementation project as
a key delivery contributor
● Demonstrated hands-on experience with subscriber data migration — bulk loading, data extension setup,
consent migration and reconciliation validation

This role acts as a primary strategic partner who maintains a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their adoption, technical health, and expertise to realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. Ensuring the seamless delivery of all deliverables necessary to advance the customer’s core business goals.


The Senior Manager is required to integrate multiple products or processes to create effective customer solutions.


"Location availability varies by vertical. Please indicate your target vertical and location in your application."
 

Preferred experience in supporting customers in the following industries:

  • Automotive industry - Worked with OEMs, dealer networks, mobility, and supply-chain organizations to accelerate innovation, improve customer success outcomes, and drive platform adoption at scale. Direct experience with Automotive Cloud is a plus.

This is an Individual Contributor position.
 

Your Impact
Strategic Accountability and Account Leadership

  • Complex Program Management: Effectively own the Signature experience across complex, multi-org customers. This involves organizing information across multiple work streams and integrating customer priorities and timelines into comprehensive success plans.
  • Resource Mobilization: Act as the central resource for the team and the customer, connecting all the dots. This includes proactively taking ownership of customer needs and drawing expert resources into customer situations as needed.
  • Business Value Integration: Align the Account Success team and internal stakeholders around the customer’s business and technical goals, ensuring value delivery through the Signature offer.

Trusted Advisory and Executive Influence

  • Advanced Stakeholder Management: Cultivate and maintain relationships with customer IT and business executive leadership, demonstrating a genuine commitment to customer goals to build deep rapport.
  • Complex Navigation: Navigate the customer’s and Salesforce’s internal organizational dynamics to achieve results. Drive consensus with collaborators and influence key internal and external stakeholders to engage in the process.
  • Business Insight: Combine expert Salesforce knowledge with deep business insight to deliver effective recommendations and advance the customer’s core business goals. This includes adapting established solutions to solve complex customer problems.
  • Customer Advocacy: Effectively amplify the voice of the customer with internal teams to ensure the organization remains laser-focused on customer success.
  • Solution & Industry Expertise: Develop a strong working knowledge of Salesforce’s major solutions and a “sales pitch” understanding of the rest. Leverage industry insight to position customers for future success.
  • Mentorship & Development: Demonstrate a growth mindset by pursuing challenging learning activities. Mentor team members to help accelerate their personal development and contribute subject matter expertise internally within Salesforce.

Domain Expertise and Risk Mitigation

  • Risk Management: Act as the leader in identifying problems. Leverage the Red Accounts Escalation Play and Case Oversight & Incident Management processes when high-value renewals or Go-Live dates are at risk.
  • AI Governance & Guardrails: Guide customers through governance frameworks, best practices for Trust Layer, and implementation of safety-by-design principles.
  • Root Cause Synthesis: Can use AI tools for account-level pattern recognition and access automated RCA reports for specific scenarios.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Question assumptions to uncover root causes and reveal new opportunities rather than just treating symptoms.

Minimum Requirements

  • Experienced business professional, preferably with 5-6 years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related strategic consulting fields.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills with a demonstrated ability to influence effectively at all levels, including executive and C-level.
  • Ability to handle objections, navigate complicated discussions, and drive alignment. Must demonstrate persistence in the face of adversity and disappointment.
  • Ability to clarify the roles and responsibilities of collaborators and serve as the central resource, ensuring clear technical and business alignment.

Cloud/Platform Requirements:

  • 5-6 years experience supporting customers using Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.

​Senior Specialist Account Executive, Data 360 & Agentforce


Team: Data 360 Specialist Sales | Location: [Germany / remote] | Languages: German and English

​The Experience


Make an impact on how organizations run
Data and AI are changing how every organization works, and this is where it’s happening. Leaders everywhere are asking how to become an agentic enterprise, where AI agents work alongside people to serve customers, solve problems, and take action in real time. Most are held back by the same obstacle: their customer data is scattered, inconsistent, and not ready for AI.

Data 360 unifies customer data in real time. Agentforce turns that data into AI agents that act for customers and employees. This is no longer a bet on the future. In Salesforce’s second quarter of fiscal 2027, Agentforce and Data 360 annual recurring revenue reached nearly $3.9 billion, up over 210% year over year. That makes them the fastest-growing part of Salesforce and the core of its growth path. They are proven at scale with world-leading organizations: Siemens uses Data 360 to power its SiePortal customer platform, AT&T uses Agentforce, Data 360 and MuleSoft to give retail experts real-time customer context, and L’Oréal uses Service Cloud and Data 360 to cut case handling time by 64% for advisors across 25 brands. Salesforce Delivers Record Second Quarter Fiscal 2027

Demand is strong and growing fast, and so is the opportunity to shape it. As a specialist, you own the growth of Data 360 and Agentforce in your assigned segment. You close deals, and you also build the market: turning proven use cases into repeatable plays, equipping colleagues to sell, and creating the reference stories that bring in the next customers.

Your impact will show up in four places:

  • On customers: you help them move from AI experiments to agents that deliver measurable results.
  • On the market: your wins become the reference stories others follow.
  • On colleagues: you equip account teams to spot and sell the opportunity.
  • On your career: high visibility and responsibility, in the fastest-growing part of Salesforce and at the center of one of the biggest shifts in business technology.



What you’ll ​Actually Be Doing

Win business

  • Identify, qualify, and close Data 360 and Agentforce opportunities, with annual contract value (ACV) as your core target.
  • Support and, where it makes sense, lead deals together with account teams, solution engineers, product specialists, and partners.
  • Lead discovery that uncovers real business problems, then judge honestly whether and how Data 360 can solve them.
  • Build clear business cases that link our solutions to measurable outcomes.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals through negotiation and close.

Grow your segment

  • Analyze ACV, pipeline, and pipeline generation for your segment, spot the gaps, and plan and carry out fixes.
  • Plan and run events and campaigns that generate pipeline and move deals forward.
  • Enable account executives with training, talk tracks, and coaching so they can spot and sell Data 360 opportunities.
  • Create and maintain selling assets such as case studies, knowledge bases, and customer stories.
  • Turn customer wins into reference stories and proven use cases into repeatable plays for your segment.
  • Share your expertise with audiences at company events, customer seminars, or other formats that suit your strengths.
  • Align with sales leaders at all levels on priorities and plans for your segment.



​Y​ou're Our Person If...

We hire for what you can do, not where or how you learned it. You don’t need every skill listed here. Tell us where you’re strongest.

Selling complex solutions

  • You can run a structured process for high-value, multi-stakeholder deals, from qualification through negotiation to close.
  • You can sell solutions customers may not yet see as urgent by connecting them to a business problem, rather than selling from a catalog.
  • You can show results against targets, in whatever context you’ve worked (enterprise, commercial, partner-led, or another model).

Analytical and strategic thinking

  • You break problems into parts, prioritize, and take action.
  • You read numbers such as pipeline, conversion, and revenue, and turn them into a plan.
  • You think about growth over the mid to long term, not just this quarter.

Ownership and adaptability

  • You take ownership of a goal and lead without needing formal authority.
  • You change your approach quickly when something isn’t working.
  • You thrive in a fast-growing market where products, competitors, and playbooks evolve every quarter.

Discovery and storytelling

  • You lead discovery conversations that surface needs customers hadn’t yet put into words.
  • You tell persuasive, evidence-based stories to both technical and business audiences.

Technical fluency

  • You understand how modern data platforms work (for example, cloud data warehouses, data lakes, customer data platforms, integration, and BI tools) well enough to hold credible conversations with technical buyers.
  • You can explain data and AI concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • You’re curious about AI agents and how they change the way businesses operate.

Collaboration and communication

  • You work well across teams and bring others along, including by teaching and enabling them.
  • You communicate and negotiate clearly in business-level German and English.


​Even Better If...

  • Experience selling or working with customer data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, analytics, or AI products
  • Experience scaling a fast-growing product or offering
  • Familiarity with the Salesforce platform, Tableau, Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery
  • Experience working with partners and system integrators



Where your skills can come from

There’s no required degree, number of years, or job title. You might have built these skills in:

  • Sales, consulting, or customer-facing technical roles
  • Product, marketing, or business development roles that owned growth for a market or segment
  • Data, analytics, or engineering roles that moved toward customers
  • Entrepreneurship, partnerships, or customer success
  • Self-study, certifications, bootcamps, military service, or a career change


If you can show you can do the work, we want to hear from you, and we want to see the impact you can make here.


How we’ll evaluate you

We assess skills directly, and every candidate goes through the same steps:

  • A practical exercise with two parts to choose from or combine: a mock discovery call or business-case presentation, and a short segment-growth plan based on sample pipeline data

D360 FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

About Salesforce

Salesforce brings customer data, CRM, analytics, and AI together on a trusted platform. Our teams help organizations turn complex business and data requirements into secure, scalable solutions. In this role, you will help customers put Data 360 into production and build the technical foundation for reliable, enterprise-grade use cases.

About the Role

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.

What You'll Do

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

You're Our Data 360 Forward Deployed Engineer If...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

Incorporate Net Promoter Score, customer and frontline feedback, and insights from industry organizations and research firms such as TSIA and Gartner to continuously shape and improve experiences that are connected, intuitive, and aligned to evolving customer expectations.

Partner across Finance, Data, Product, Sales, and other organizations to create a consistent, connected view of performance, impact, and opportunity.

Own strategic planning and operating cadences, executive reviews, leadership communications, and cross-functional coordination, while serving as a trusted strategic partner and executive delegate to the EVP of Cloud Success.   • Mobility: Travel to client sites for onsite discovery and solutions presentations (estimated 25% - 50%).

You will work on some of Slack's highest-impact business questions, applying advanced analytics, experimentation, and statistical methods to understand customer behavior, evaluate strategic initiatives, and optimize GTM performance. As Slack continues to invest in AI-powered selling and customer intelligence, you will help define the analytical frameworks, predictive models, and measurement systems that enable smarter decisions at scale.


You will collaborate closely with Engineers, Business Leaders, and Researchers to identify opportunities, influence strategic direction, and build a culture of evidence-based decision making.


Slack has a positive, diverse, and supportive culture. We look for people who are curious, inventive, and strive to improve every day. In our work together, we aim to be smart, humble, hardworking, and, above all, collaborative. If this sounds like a great fit, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing


  • Partner with GTM leadership to identify strategic opportunities, evaluate business performance, and influence key business decisions.
  • Apply statistical methods, experimentation, and advanced analytics to understand customer behavior, sales performance, and drivers of business growth.
  • Develop predictive models, segmentation frameworks, and forecasting methodologies that improve GTM planning and execution.
  • Design measurement strategies and success metrics to evaluate products, programs, and strategic initiatives.

  • Champion evidence-based decision making by improving access to trusted metrics, analytical methodologies, and strategic insights across the GTM organization.

  • Expertise in experimental design, A/B testing, causal inference, forecasting, or machine learning.
  • Experience developing production-quality analytical models and partnering with engineering teams to operationalize data science solutions.
  • Deep understanding of GTM operating models and experience collaborating with Sales Strategy and Sales Programs teams.

Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Solution Engineering careers. Introduction Month

The Experience

At Salesforce, we're seeking outstanding individuals to join our team as an Apromore Account Executive with a strong technical background and expertise in process intelligence & AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will be pivotal in driving revenue growth, encouraging enduring client relationships and applying innovative process intelligence technology to redefine customer engagement.

Apromore is a global leader in AI-driven process intelligence technology. Now part of Salesforce, Apromore provides organizations with an "Intelligent Process Twin" to gain complete operational transparency. As enterprises rush to scale AI, Apromore bridges the gap between process perception and reality, acting as the critical backbone that enables organizations to systematically discover, de-risk, deploy, and govern Agentic AI automation across the enterprise.

As a part of our Apromore AE selling team, you will act as a strategic prospector and evangelist for Apromore, Salesforce's process intelligence platform, focusing heavily on Agentic AI adoption. You will target, among others, enterprise clients who are scaling AI into production, positioning Apromore as the definitive mechanism to identify the ideal high-propensity, high-ROI use cases for AI agents (such as Agentforce). You will navigate complex, enterprise-grade B2B sales cycles by helping C-level executives move away from broad anecdotes and scope precisely defined, value-driven automation pipelines. We are looking for individuals with strong experience in selling process intelligence/process mining solutions, understanding AI and cloud-based services, and designing bespoke B2B solutions.



What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Drive Agentic AI Adoption: Employ your wealth of sales knowledge, to position Apromore as the key solution for scaling AI initiatives such as Agentforce, showing customers how clean process context, clear handoffs, and well-understood workflows are required to deploy agents safely and productively.
  • Deliver Value-Based Messaging: Target executive decision makers across Automation/AI, Digital Transformation, Operational Excellence, and Risk & Compliance to map process frictions directly to financial business impact.
  • Conduct comprehensive technical discovery to analyze sophisticated business problems and craft compelling Points of View that underscore the tangible value of Apromore across both business and technical users
  • Manage Full Sales Lifecycles: Own end-to-end B2B sales processes—from pipeline generation and prospecting to qualifying and closing complex enterprise software transactions.
  • Sustain Continuous Value Post-Deployment: Shift clients from an initial deployment mindset to long-term partnerships. Drive ongoing account expansion by selling further process intelligence capabilities to ensure realized value scales with their business.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Value Engineers, Solution Consultants, and Salesforce sales teams to deliver a unified "One Salesforce" enterprise experience.



You're Our Person If...


  • 10+ Years of Enterprise Software Sales Experience: Proven track record of selling enterprise SaaS, cloud software, or complex business analytics tools to executive buyers.
  • Proven Process Intelligence Expertise: Deep background selling process intelligence and related technologies, such as process analytics, task mining and simulation (e.g. from Celonis, SAP Signavio, ARIS).
  • Sophisticated intuition for business and able to conduct technical in-depth discovery mapping aligning clients needs to the Apromore platform
  • Strong technical selling skills including the ability to explain process intelligence solutions to non-technical clients and how such solutions can translate to business outcomes
  • A proven track record of consistently surpassing sales targets within a technical sales environment, underscoring your proficiency in intricate sales processes.
  • Outstanding communication and negotiation skills honed through your experience

Even Better If...


  • Industry/Vertical Knowledge: Deep insight into Financial Services, Energy & Utilities or Manufacturing & Supply Chains.
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with extensive background in technology sales.



Key Attributes We’re Looking For:

  • This role requires an outstanding blend of technical depth, sales competence, and can articulate complex AI-driven solutions to a mix of customers.
  • Results motivated: you show your ability to exceed sales goals.
  • Business-focused outlook: Skillfully translates technical solutions into palpable business value
  • A talent for relationship-building: Establishes enduring client connections, rooted in your extensive sales expertise.
  • A curiosity about problem-solving: Devises innovative solutions to address sophisticated client challenges, using your extensive technology sales experience
  • Technical Skills: Ability to understand sophisticated technical solutions and clearly articulate business value to businesses and technical partners
  • Creativity. Agile, roll-up-your-sleeves demeanor. Progress over perfection.

Chez Salesforce, nous recherchons des talents exceptionnels pour rejoindre nos équipes en tant qu'Account Executive Apromore, disposant d'un solide bagage technique et d'une expertise reconnue en process intelligence et en solutions pilotées par l'IA. À ce poste, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour stimuler la croissance du chiffre d'affaires, développer des relations clients durables et exploiter des technologies innovantes de process intelligence afin de redéfinir l'engagement client.


À propos d'Apromore

Apromore est un leader mondial de la technologie de process intelligence pilotée par l'IA. Faisant désormais partie de Salesforce, Apromore fournit aux entreprises un « jumeau numérique de processus » (Intelligent Process Twin) pour leur offrir une transparence opérationnelle totale. Alors que les entreprises s'efforcent d'incrémenter l'IA à grande échelle, Apromore comble le fossé entre la perception des processus et leur réalité du terrain. La solution sert de socle critique permettant aux organisations de découvrir, sécuriser, déployer et gouverner de manière systématique l'automatisation par l'IA agentique à l'échelle de l'entreprise.


À propos du rôle

Au sein de notre équipe de vente spécialisée Apromore, vous agirez en tant que chasseur stratégique et évangéliste pour Apromore, la plateforme de process intelligence de Salesforce, avec une forte orientation vers l'adoption de l'IA agentique. Vous cibleriez, entre autres, des comptes Entreprise qui déploient l'IA en production, en positionnant Apromore comme le mécanisme incontournable pour identifier les cas d'usage à fort ROI et à forte valeur ajoutée pour les agents IA (tels qu'Agentforce). Vous piloterez des cycles de vente B2B complexes en aidant les dirigeants C-Level à dépasser les idées reçues pour définir des pipelines d'automatisation précis et créateurs de valeur. Nous recherchons des profils disposant d'une solide expérience dans la vente de solutions de process intelligence / process mining, comprenant les enjeux de l'IA et des services Cloud, et capables de concevoir des solutions B2B sur mesure.


Vos missions :

  • Stimuler l'adoption de l'IA agentique : Mettre à profit votre expertise commerciale pour positionner Apromore comme la solution clé de la mise à l'échelle des initiatives d'IA (comme Agentforce), en démontrant aux clients qu'un contexte de processus clair, des passages de relais fluides et des flux de travail bien maîtrisés sont indispensables pour déployer des agents de manière sûre et productive.
  • Délivrer un message à forte valeur ajoutée : Cibler les décideurs exécutifs (Automatisations/IA, Transformation Numérique, Excellence Opérationnelle, Risques & Conformité) pour relier directement les dysfonctionnements opérationnels à leur impact financier.

Stimuler l'expansion des comptes (upsell) en vendant de nouvelles capacités de process intelligence pour garantir que la valeur générée suive la croissance de leur activité.
  • Collaboration transversale : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes d'Ingénierie de la Valeur (Value Engineers), les Consultants Avant-Vente (Solution Consultants) et les équipes commerciales Salesforce afin d'offrir une expérience entreprise unifiée (« One Salesforce »).

Votre profil :

  • 10+ ans d'expérience dans la vente de logiciels Entreprise : Track record éprouvé dans la vente de SaaS Entreprise, de logiciels Cloud ou d'outils complexes d'analyse de données auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs.

  • Sens aigu des affaires : Capacité à mener des découvertes techniques approfondies et à aligner les besoins clients sur la plateforme Apromore.

Overview of the Role 

Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes - email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. The economy moves fast but supply chains don’t, creating an inefficiency that affects the $13T of goods shipped annually and is one of the largest untapped opportunities in modern enterprise.


Agentforce for Supply Chain is reimagining the supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and running end-to-end business processes. Customers are clamoring for more, rapidly expanding their use cases as we enter an exhilarating growth phase.


We are looking for an early-career, highly driven Value Acceleration Engineer to join us for a unique, high-impact "tour of duty." In this forward-deployed role, you will be on the front lines of our post-sales engine, embedding directly with our enterprise customers and Customer Success teams to bring AI concepts to life and compress their time-to-value. You will be the technical muscle that unblocks implementations, designs agentic workflows, and helps gets 1-2 critical business processes live in production during an intensive 90-day window.


This role is designed as a rotational "Field Residency." After spending your first 6-12 months mastering production edge cases, developing deep customer empathy, and learning the real-world complexities our customers face, you will rotate back into a core AFO product and engineering pod. You will bring those invaluable frontline insights with you to help us build the paved pathways of our future platform.


Responsibilities

Day-to-Day & Project Execution

  • Work hands-on with strategic customers to design and build "Day 1" agentic workflows and blueprints.
  • Participate in 90-day Value Acceleration programs, acting as the technical builder to get 1-2 primary use cases live in production.
  • Quickly troubleshoot bugs, unblock implementation hurdles, and solve usability or security asks to drastically reduce Time-to-First-Value (TTFV).
  • Facilitate working sessions with customers and deployment strategists, bridging the gap between business needs and technical feasibility.
  • Enable and support implementation partners to take over ongoing build work post-engagement.

Long-Term Goals & Strategic Impact

  • Document design decisions and build patterns from your bespoke customer engagements to feed our use case library and core product roadmap.
  • Serve as the feedback loop between the customer edge and mainline engineering, translating real-world friction into scalable product features.
  • Successfully graduate from your forward-deployed rotation, transitioning your hands-on deployment expertise into a permanent builder role within the core product pods.

Experience Gained & Impact Made

  • Experience Gained: You will receive a masterclass in real-world software deployment. Through our Value Acceleration Residency curriculum, you will move rapidly from shadowing senior team members to independently owning end-to-end customer projects. You will learn how large enterprise supply chains operate on the ground, master customer empathy, and build a unique techno-functional skillset.
  • Impact Made: Your work will directly accelerate time-to-value for our most strategic accounts, clearing onboarding blockers, and setting the stage for massive account expansion. You will be the critical link that turns a signed deal into a highly successful, live deployment.

Required Qualifications

  • B.S. in Computer Science or related field, with 3.5+ GPA (M.S. is a plus). Early-career engineers (0-3 years of experience) are highly encouraged to apply.
  • A builder's spirit (you've built something on the side just for the fun of it, stay on top of tech developments, etc.).
  • High empathy and exceptional written and verbal communication skills; you must be comfortable presenting to external customers and navigating complex enterprise environments.
  • A strong desire to learn both technical systems and business processes.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment where quick problem-solving is required to unblock implementations.
  • Enthusiasm for a rotational model: excited to spend the first phase of your career at the company deployed in the field before transitioning into core product engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, JavaScript) and a proven ability to pick up new technologies quickly.
  • Previous experience, projects, or internships in customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Sales Engineering, Tech Consulting, Implementation).
  • Hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform or building agentic workflows/blueprints.

The Experience
We're hiring DevOps talent across levels — from Senior DevOps Engineer to DevOps Architect — to support enterprise Salesforce implementations. This posting covers both levels; candidates will be matched to the appropriate role based on experience.

The Salesforce DevOps Architect/Engineer is responsible for advising, designing, and managing deployment orchestration solutions for complex Salesforce implementations. This role requires close collaboration with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, Solution Architects, and Account Teams, as well as direct client engagement to architect and deliver DevOps solutions tailored to client needs.

This is a hands-on role involving both architectural work and, when necessary, deployment execution. You are both a big-picture thinker and an in-depth problem solver, with broad and deep technical expertise, taking pride in designing resilient systems that withstand high volumes and critical demands while balancing technical and enterprise-level considerations.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations.
  • Assess existing DevOps processes, tools, and practices, recommending improvements.
  • Design, present, and implement best-fit DevOps solutions, considering customer needs, tool preferences, and commercial constraints.
  • Drive the selection and implementation of DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Lead DevOps design sessions, architect solutions, and document best practices (Architect level); lead setup and execution of DevOps frameworks for small-to-medium projects and support Architects on larger engagements (Senior Engineer level).
  • Develop and enforce DevOps frameworks and governance models for consistency across deployments.
  • Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects.
  • Ensure successful continuous delivery deployments across environments.
  • Support pre-sales activities, including discovery sessions, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept (PoC) development.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations.
  • Champion an AI-first development/DevOps workflow using advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce development, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and deployment processes while maintaining platform security, performance, governance, and Salesforce best practices.
  • Practical fluency with AI coding assistants and modern development/DevOps ecosystems to maximize productivity, automate workflows, document implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, high-quality solutions.
  • Travel to client sites as needed (estimated 50-75%, Architect level).



You're Our Person If...

  • 6+ years of Salesforce platform experience (Senior DevOps Engineer) or 10+ years of CRM experience with at least 8 years on the Salesforce platform (DevOps Architect), with a focus on DevOps, release management, and CI/CD implementation.
  • Expert/strong knowledge of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Experience, Industries (Vlocity), and Data Cloud.
  • Strong understanding of environment management, release management, version control best practices, and deployment methodologies.
  • Understanding of branching strategies (Git Flow, Trunk-based development, Feature branching).
  • Salesforce Development Lifecycle – Metadata API, SFDX (Salesforce DX), Salesforce CLI, Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Salesforce Release & Deployment Strategies – Sandbox management, source-driven development, Change Sets, Unlocked & Managed Packages.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools: Copado, Flosum, Gearset, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, CircleCI.
  • Experience with Version Control Systems – Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, Azure Repos.
  • Experience with Docker image building, orchestration, and pipelines, and security integration into CI/CD.
  • Experience with test automation (Provar, Copado Robotic Testing, TOSCA, TestNG, Selenium, WebDriver, JUnit, JMeter, ApexUnit).
  • Experience with code quality/security tools (SonarQube, Checkmarx, PMD).
  • Understanding of performance monitoring tools (Salesforce Event Monitoring, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor).
  • Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to lead small/medium projects or support Architects on large-scale programs.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Technology, or equivalent experience.
  • Salesforce certifications (active or ability to obtain upon hire).

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

For our customers who wish to get the most value out of Salesforce with enterprise and rapid support, delivered by our most skilled experts, they purchase our Signature Success Plan. When you have Signature, you unlock our deepest level of partnership, most skilled expertise, and tools to stay agile.

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will serve as a named resource and partner for Salesforce’s customer organizations. You are a trusted advisor, forging deep relationships with your customers and account teams and maintaining an awareness of key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers. With a continual focus on your customers’ business needs, you will help to improve their overall technical and operational health, helping them to realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. You will act as a point of contact for any major customer incidents, being responsible for managing expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents.

These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimisation of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events. This will require deep technical knowledge of the Salesforce platform, and the ability to work closely across internal and external teams to provide a unified Signature experience.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, renewal, and expansion.
  • Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organisations that have purchased Signature.
  • Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
  • Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer.
  • Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer.
  • Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation.
  • Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
  • Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high-severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
  • The CSM may be required for occasional travel to customer sites and may need to be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage, depending on the customer’s need.


Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum of 8 years of work experience in one or more of the following: Technical Customer Success, Salesforce CRM or SaaS platform use, project leadership, technology solutions development, technical solutions, and/or solutions architecture.
  • Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud and/or a relevant competing platform.
  • 4+ years’ experience in management consulting services,
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organisation, including executive and C-level.
  • Skills for analysing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and mapping business requirements into technical features.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
  • Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies.
  • Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate the resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.


Preferred Requirements


  • Salesforce product certifications are a plus (AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, and Service Cloud Consultant).
  • Knowledge of Salesforce products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy.
  • Experience working with Enterprise-level customers.


Note: This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in office 3 days per week

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Applicants are welcome to opt-in to the interview scheme as part of the application process. If you would like to apply under the scheme, please click the link to the Accommodations Request Form above and scroll to the UK Disability Confident Scheme section within the form.

descriptionHtml:

About Salesforce
