Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience


The Internal Audit Organization is an independent and objective function that assists Salesforce to meet its goals through independent reviews and assessments. Specifically, the Internal Audit Organization evaluates and provides recommendations to enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability of the company’s processes, information systems, and underlying internal control environment. The Internal Audit Organization also evaluates and assists in improving the effectiveness of the Company’s risk management and governance processes. This function reports administratively to the President and Chief Operating and Financial Officer (COFO) and directly to the Audit and Finance Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors.


Internal Audit is modernizing the way we perform our audits, using technology, AI, and analytics to fuel the transformation. We are looking for an Internal Auditor to excel with an amazing team to support you. You will have the opportunity to support audit activities for the Company’s technology and product functions (e.g., Business Technology, Engineering, Product Management), with a growing focus on how AI and agentic capabilities are adopted, governed, and controlled across these functions.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

Success will be measured upon the Auditor successfully executing key tasks, including:

  • Support audits that assess risks and controls over AI and agentic capabilities embedded in business processes — including access and authorization, guardrail enforcement, data grounding, third-party AI/LLM dependencies, and Responsible AI considerations
  • Help evaluate how company and customer data is used by AI tools and connected platforms, including data minimization, masking, consent, logging, and monitoring
  • Be intellectually curious and passionate about internal audit, learning about new processes, systems, and technologies (including AI) and how to make them better, driven by “doing the right thing”, effectively maneuver through the organization, influence others, and keep up with a dynamic and fast-changing environment
  • Be a team-oriented individual who can effectively work at all levels within the organization, both within Audit and by collaborating with other 2nd line risk and compliance teams and 1st line business partners
  • Be a “self-starter” with the ability to manage project commitments independently, with minimal oversight
  • Assist Senior Auditors and Audit Managers / Senior Managers with planning and general team functions
  • Assist with planning, fieldwork, and reporting throughout the audit life cycle
  • Develop a strong understanding of Salesforce's business model, processes, systems, and underlying controls, and influence positive change in these areas
  • Be knowledgeable in project management best practices including project plans, charters, and task management
  • Individually and with the team, build relationships and work with process owners to understand and document their operations and the underlying internal control environment
  • Develop and execute audit testing procedures to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls
  • Use AI and generative-AI tooling (e.g., agentic assistants and AI-enabled GRC/eGRC workflows) to accelerate audit planning, testing, and documentation, applying “human-at-the-helm” review of AI-generated output and adhering to the team's AI governance framework (data classification, data-exposure, and consumption considerations)
  • Seek opportunities to automate repetitive audit test procedures and improve testing efficiency through data analytics and AI
  • Prepare high-quality audit work papers documenting the test steps performed and the results and recommendations
  • Deliver assigned audit tasks and other project tasks within required deadlines and with minimal supervision, with a focus on delivering quality and adhering to global audit methodologies
  • Manage issue follow up and closure process for open Management Action plans, resulting from past audits
  • Stay abreast of best practices, both internally and externally, and provide a conduit for introducing those practices to the Company
  • Be a role model for the Company’s values and demonstrate the highest ethical standards

You're Our Person If...

  • A minimum of 1-2 years experience in Internal Audit, Compliance, or Risk Assurance and the ability to demonstrate:
    • Understanding of and experience with the audit life cycle
    • Understanding of audit best practices in the form of planning, fieldwork, and reporting
    • Experience working with business owners and teams in an audit capacity
    • Comfort adopting and experimenting with new AI/GenAI tools in a controlled, responsible manner (“builder” / Customer-Zero mindset)
  • Strong understanding of operational and IT internal control methodologies and terminology (e.g., COSO, COBIT), including documentation and testing
  • Foundational understanding of AI governance and Responsible AI concepts — e.g., model risk, third-party AI/LLM supply chain, and AI security
  • Familiarity with AI risk and governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and knowledge of and ability to research and apply the guidance to a changing control environment
  • Familiarity with data protection and privacy concepts, including data residency and jurisdictional (cross-border) data controls
  • Highest level of ethics, independence, and professionalism
  • Strong analytical and data analysis skills
  • Ability to work in a high-growth, fast-paced environment, often on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to work with minimal day-to-day supervision
  • Understanding of business processes related to technology companies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities
  • Intellectual curiosity 
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools, such as Tableau (including Tableau Next), and modern data platforms 
  • Experience auditing IT general controls
  • Exposure to auditing or using AI/ML systems, LLM-based applications, or agentic workflows 
  • Comfortable working and supporting a fully global, multicultural, and distributed team
  • Knowledge about cloud computing, AI, or technology businesses and processes

Even Better If...

  • CPA, CIA,CISA, or other relevant audit certifications, including AI-audit / AI-governance certifications (e.g., ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent)

Preferred Locations

  • Primary Location: Dallas
  • Secondary locations: Atlanta, Indianapolis

Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.


Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.


Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.

Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.

The Experience
我們正在尋找對協助客戶進行數位轉型與業務流程優化有熱情、有想法的夥伴。您將主導從企業系統願景規劃、策略擬定，到實際導入與落地運行的完整流程，並帶領客戶與團隊運用 Salesforce 平台實現業務願景與目標。同時，您也將有機會持續接觸最前沿的 AI 與 CRM 趨勢及技術，拓展專業能力和職涯邊界。

職位特色

  • 結合策略規劃及落地執行：作為顧問或主要合作夥伴（Prime Vendor）的角色，參與具代表性的轉型專案，從前期策略規劃到實際導入上線，協助客戶將轉型藍圖落實為可執行的成果。
  • 應用前沿 AI 技術：協助客戶評估與導入 Agentforce 等新一代 AI 解決方案。使用各式 AI 工具，提升分析深度、設計品質與交付效率。
  • 端到端 (End-to-End) 參與：從願景規劃、架構設計到上線後的落地運行與持續優化，參與專案各個關鍵階段，累積完整且具深度的實戰經驗。


主要角色類型
依據您的專業背景，入職後將主要參與以下其中一類角色：

  • PM (Project Manager/Engagement Delivery Manager)：負責專案規劃、進度推動與交付管理。
  • BA (Business Architect)：負責商業策略、流程設計與應用推廣。
  • SA (Solution Architect)：負責整體解決方案、資料模型與多雲架構設計。
  • TA (Technical Architect)：負責技術架構、系統整合、資安與效能優化。


What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • B. 專案執行與支援 (Project Execution & Support)：從需求定義到上線發佈，在各階段提供支援或執行實務工作。根據專案特性選擇瀑布式（Waterfall）或敏捷式（Agile）開發。專案管理：參與專案規劃、進度推動與執行管理。需求定義：進行需求訪談、需求分析與流程引導。設計：主導或參與應用設計、架構設計與詳細設計，並審查相關成果。開發與測試：領導實作與測試工作，或制定開發標準及品質管理流程。遷移與部署：執行資料遷移與部署上線，或制定遷移策略並支援執行。CI/CD：協助建立開發標準，開發環境設計、構建與運維等 DevOps 流程。

You're Our Person If...

  • 學習及理解力：具備學習新技術的意願與行動力，並願意善用 AI 工具提升工作效率與產出品質
  • 核心思維：具備實踐「批判性思考 (Critical Thinking)」與「歸零學習 (Unlearning)」的能力。
  • 核心思維：不過度執著於過去的成功經驗，能針對 AI 等新技術靈活調整自身的思考模式與方法論。

The Experience
We are looking for passionate, forward-thinking partners who want to help customers with digital transformation and business process optimization. You will lead the full journey, from enterprise system vision and strategy through to actual implementation and live operation, guiding customers and teams to use the Salesforce platform to achieve their business vision and goals. You will also keep getting exposure to the latest AI and CRM trends and technologies, expanding your professional capabilities and career boundaries.

Strategy & Change Design: Define the overall transformation vision and blueprint for the organization and its systems.Organization and business transformation design: Plan the overall framework for business process reform and organizational change.   • B. Project Execution & Support: Provide support or hands-on work at every stage, from requirements definition to release. Waterfall or Agile development is chosen based on the nature of the project.Project management: Take part in project planning, driving progress, and execution management.Requirements definition: Conduct requirements interviews, requirements analysis, and process facilitation.Design: Lead or take part in application design, architecture design, and detailed design, and review related deliverables.Development and testing: Lead implementation and testing, or define development standards and quality management processes.Migration and deployment: Carry out data migration and deployment to production, or define the migration strategy and support its execution.CI/CD: Help establish development standards and DevOps processes such as development environment design, build, and operations.

Governance & OptimizationSalesforce Governance: Help establish Salesforce governance mechanisms and the operating model of a CoE (Center of Excellence).Design Authority: Establish or take part in design review and architecture governance processes to ensure design quality.Design quality best practices: Provide design best practices and optimization recommendations to improve project delivery quality.Architecture Optimization: Run Org health checks, architecture diagnostics, and optimization recommendations for existing environments.

  • Core mindset: Able to practice critical thinking and unlearning.

As a Customer Success Senior Manager, you are a key driver of value for your customers. You move beyond initial implementation to ensure deep, operationalized adoption of contracted use cases. What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Support the Customer Center of Excellence (CoE): Partner with customers in building and nurturing their internal CoE. Train “Agent Champions” and empower customers to independently iterate, govern, and scale their AI footprint.
  • Data-Driven Governance & Telemetry: Monitor agent performance telemetry, success rates, and friction points to identify where agents are stalling. Use data-driven insights to proactively recommend optimizations to the customer’s workflows.
  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Support the customer’s Agentic Enterprise journey by coordinating with Salesforce Account Executives, Professional Services, and Third-Party Consulting Partners/SIs to ensure a unified customer experience.
  • Drive Deep Consumption: Proactively manage the roadmap for contracted licenses and consumption credits. Success is measured by the customer’s ability to fully utilize their investment against high-impact processes.

Salesforce is seeking a Systems Engineer to support the technical operation, reliability, and continued evolution of Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE). This individual will partner with Marketing, Product, and Data to support MCE operations.

This is a hands-on technical operations and implementation role. You will co-own key MCE capabilities including Preference Center, Global Footer, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Extension management, DE audience and segmentation logic, and Mobile Push. You will translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, troubleshoot complex production issues, and improve the operating model for customer-facing messaging.

The role is ideal for an individual who is comfortable working at the intersection of marketing technology, data, automation, and production support.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Build, configure, test, and maintain email and mobile messaging journeys in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.
  • Use Journey Builder and Automation Studio to implement customer journeys, triggered communications, scheduled automations, data imports, and operational workflows.
  • Write query plan optimized SQL queries with complicating joins
  • Design, manage, and troubleshoot Data Extensions, data models, SQL queries, audience tables, suppression logic, and automation dependencies.
  • Support Preference Center and subscription-management experiences, including consent, unsubscribe processing, compliance controls, localization, and subscriber-state troubleshooting.
  • Own and evolve Global Footer implementations and reusable messaging components across campaigns, regions, and communication types.
  • Support MCE Mobile Push campaigns, including audience targeting, segment qualification, exclusions, message configuration, send readiness, delivery monitoring, and event-week operational coverage.
  • Diagnose issues involving missing or stale source data, empty or incorrect audiences, duplicate-send risk, automation failures, journey entry and exit logic, and delayed or failed sends.
  • Validate audience counts, representative audience members, source-data freshness, exclusions, and send configuration before production launches.
  • Partner with Marketing and Product stakeholders to turn business requirements into technical solution documents, configuration plans, implementation steps, test cases, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with upstream data owners, segmentation teams, mobile teams, and platform engineering teams to resolve dependencies and establish clear escalation paths.
  • Participate in incident response for MCE capabilities, including triage, investigation, stakeholder communication, escalation, resolution, and follow-up. Participate in a formal on-call rotation (e.g., PagerDuty) to support critical incident response, triage, and resolution outside of standard business hours.
  • Improve monitoring, alert quality, dashboards, documentation, operational controls, and incident-prevention practices for messaging systems.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, reduce operational risk, improve compliance safeguards, and make campaign delivery more reliable at scale.
  • Maintain appropriate standards for data privacy, consent management, localization, testing, change management, and customer-impacting production work.


Minimum Requirements

  • 5 years of working with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement at large scale companies.
  • Hands-on experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Extensions, SQL Query Activities, and email-send or campaign-execution workflows.
  • Strong SQL skills, including audience qualification, deduplication, suppression, segmentation, and data-validation queries.
  • Experience troubleshooting production workflows involving data ingestion, automations, audience selection, journey logic, and message delivery.
  • Experience translating business requirements into clear technical designs, implementation documentation, and validation plans.
  • Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical partners, including marketers, product managers, analysts, and data engineers.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and comfort operating in time-sensitive production environments.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical documentation and status updates.
  • Experience with AMPscript, HTML, CSS, email templates, content blocks, CloudPages, or triggered sends.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Preference Center, consent-management, unsubscribe, subscription, or privacy-compliance workflows.
  • Experience supporting mobile push-notification campaigns, including targeting, audience readiness, delivery monitoring, and incident response.
  • Experience operating reusable global email components or localized footer and compliance content.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Data Cloud and its MCE connector
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, logs, alerting, or incident-management platforms such as PagerDuty.
  • Experience supporting high-visibility campaigns, large events, or customer-facing communications with strict execution windows.
  • Familiarity with localization and regional messaging requirements, including content, consent, and footer variations by country or language.

A successful individual in this role will become a trusted technical owner for Marketing Cloud Engagement operations. They will support and improve journey execution, audience and data workflows, preference-management experiences, global email components, and mobile push programs.

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Who are we looking for?

  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
  • You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Norwegian (essential)

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations

  • During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
  • If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.
  • Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Examples of what you can expect during the rotations


Sales Graduate Rotation

  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation

  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

What’s in it for you?

  • A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years


With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path, you can continue to progress:

About the Role
The Life Sciences Program Executive (PE) is a senior, executive-facing individual contributor (IC) within the Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub at Salesforce. As an IC, Program Executives hold no direct reports, and yet expertly lead large numbers of our most senior talent across our most complex Life Sciences customer engagements: multi-workstream transformations, strategic accounts, and enterprise implementations where the margin for error is narrow and the consequences of failure are visible at the C-suite.
The PE is fully allocated to a single flagship Life Sciences transformation program or a set of strategic accounts. They own the end-to-end program P&L, lead the Salesforce project team, run the steering committee, manage the executive customer relationship, manage scope, govern the budget, and surface risk before it becomes an escalation. The ideal candidate brings a deep background in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) combined with IT or management consulting delivery experience, leveraging that industry credibility as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams across Salesforce.
Life Sciences Program Executives sit at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations that accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations through intelligent, autonomous agents. They lead cross-functional teams deploying digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex Life Sciences data and actionable business outcomes, driving the next frontier of Life Sciences innovation.
Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

Your Impact
* AI and agentic delivery are embedded in how you work: you actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize how your program teams deliver. You reduce manual overhead, accelerate insight, and model the productivity gains Life Sciences customers are investing in Salesforce to achieve.
* Engagement success is well-defined and honored: you create the program strategy, management approach, governance, and guide the customer at the executive and program level to align on objectives, outcomes, and KPIs.
* Customer outcomes are owned with clear accountability: you are the executive-facing delivery contact for your engagement and are responsible for communications with the client and within Salesforce up to the CxO level regarding expectations, performance, governance, and issue escalation and resolution. You earn trust through consistently accurate forecasting, honest risk communication, and follow-through.
* The delivery team performs at a higher level because you're in it: you effectively lead, inspire, and uplift Salesforce Professional Services team members, coaching them to perform at a higher level while contributing to the internal processes, artifacts, and methodologies that raise the floor for service delivery across our most strategic Life Sciences accounts. What you learn and implement travels.
* The full engagement is yours to deliver: you are accountable for overseeing end-to-end service delivery and meeting every contractual commitment. Bid-versus-delivered margin is your financial accountability.
* Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep Life Sciences industry and product expertise. You align IT strategy, governance, processes, and stakeholder decisions to ensure adoption and consumption directly deliver measurable customer impact.
* Risk is managed before it manages you: you anticipate, mitigate, and manage risk to Salesforce and the customer, taking decisive program action to address risk profiles. You raise signals with a recommended path, not just a problem statement. Surfacing a risk is success; being surprised by one is not.
* White space becomes pipeline and internal alignment sustains it: you proactively build and expand business relationships which enable Salesforce to support, transform and win business that delivers mutual value, working hand in hand with Sales, Success, Technology and Product, and Support to drive customer adoption initiatives and maintain alignment as One Salesforce.

Minimum Requirements
* Demonstrated experience applying AI productivity tools, automation, or agentic workflows within a professional services or program delivery context, with measurable impact on delivery efficiency or customer outcomes
* 12+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, with direct accountability for program execution across financials, risk, scope, and customer outcomes
* Demonstrated track record leading large, complex programs ($10M+) with measurable outcomes
* 5+ years of direct Life Sciences industry experience (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) sufficient to engage credibly at the executive level on commercial, regulatory, and operational priorities
* 5+ years leading large, cross-functional delivery teams across multiple geographies and workstreams, including third-party system integrators, without positional authority
* Direct experience managing program financials at the engagement level, including forecasting, revenue control, earned value analysis, and delivered-versus-bid margin
* End-to-end knowledge of system development, implementation, and operational readiness within Life Sciences environments, including familiarity with regulated industry requirements
* Proven ability to lead steering committee and executive-level customer relationships, including difficult data-driven conversations around budget, resources, timelines, and outcomes
* Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, verbal and written, with the ability to tailor messaging across technical, commercial, and regulatory audiences
* Must be able to operate as a fully billable IC

Preferred Qualifications
* Hands-on experience delivering Agentforce or equivalent AI platform implementations at the enterprise level, with the ability to credibly advise Life Sciences customers on agentic transformation
* Deep knowledge of Life Sciences commercial operations: field engagement, HCP engagement, territory management, sampling, MSL workflows, compliance controls, and data-driven customer insights
* Experience with Life Sciences Cloud or equivalent CRM platforms purpose-built for pharma and biotech
* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification, or equivalent demonstrated program management discipline applied at scale
* Salesforce platform certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud); certifications are a requirement of the role and available through the global education reimbursement program
* Experience operating in outcomes-based or fixed-fee delivery models where margin is set at the proposal and protected through execution discipline
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate and resolve conflict in a delivery context, including change order negotiation, scope dispute resolution, and steering committee decision-forcing

Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value. Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
  • AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
  • Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
  • Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
  • AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
  • Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development. 
  • Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
  • AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
  • Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.


Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
  • Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
  • Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
  • Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
  • Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
  • Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
  • Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
  • Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
  • Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
  • Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
  • Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
  • A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

Un impact client dès le premier jour. Une vision stratégique claire et une exécution qui dure.

Salesforce recrute des Deployment Strategists — des Strategic Builders qui sont des conseillers en contact direct avec les clients, définissent la stratégie IA, façonnent des solutions agentiques et pilotent une adoption mesurable pour les entreprises clientes. We are hiring a Member of Technical Staff to build and operate the automation that keeps third-party and open-source dependencies across a large service fleet patched, auditable, and shipped on time. You will own feature-level work on the pipelines that discover vulnerable packages, decide what to upgrade, open fix PRs across many repositories, and track those fixes through to deployed production artifacts.


This role is pitched at engineers who are strong in pipeline and automation work and are ready to grow into software supply chain security as the problem domain — not at supply chain specialists who code on the side. We will teach you the standards (CVE, CVSS, SBOM, SLSA, Sigstore) if you bring the engineering fundamentals.


Responsibilities:


Pipeline Development & Operations


  • Contribute to data pipelines that ingest vulnerability data, dependency manifests, SBOM artifacts, and deployment metadata into a queryable analytics store.
  • Build and maintain batch and streaming jobs with idempotent steps, retries, and clear failure modes.
  • Operate what you ship: on-call for the pipelines you own, debug production failures, and reduce toil through automation.

Repository-wide Automation


  • Build scripts and small services that interact with many repositories at once — opening PRs, parsing diffs, reading CI feedback, and reconciling the results back into a central store.
  • Author and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated test coverage so remediation PRs can be reviewed and merged with confidence.
  • Resolve attribution issues at the source rather than patching symptoms downstream.

Collaboration & Communication


  • Partner with service owners to land dependency upgrades, triage breakage, and raise the quality of generated fix PRs.
  • Translate noisy scanner output into prioritized, actionable work for engineering teams.
  • Write clear design docs, runbooks, and PR descriptions; keep documentation current when behavior changes.

Quality & Growth


  • Write Python and Java code that matches the conventions of the existing codebase and holds up under review.
  • Add regression tests for every bug you fix; treat failing tests as signal rather than noise.
  • Learn the supply chain domain on the job — vulnerability lifecycle, dependency resolution, artifact provenance — and bring that knowledge back into the pipelines you build.

Required Skills / Experience

  • Industry Experience: 3+ years in software engineering with strong proficiency in Python and Java, and reading-fluency in at least two of Node.js, Go, and Ruby.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on experience contributing to data pipelines — batch or streaming — including writing idempotent steps and reasoning about retries.
  • CI/CD: Direct experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with automated test coverage.
  • Repo-wide Automation: Comfort writing scripts or small services that interact with many repositories — opening PRs, parsing diffs, handling CI feedback.
  • Workflow Orchestration and Query Engines: Experience with a workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Temporal) and a lakehouse / columnar query engine (Trino, Presto, Spark, Snowflake, BigQuery, Athena, Databricks, or Iceberg).
  • SQL: Non-trivial joins, window functions, CTEs.
  • Individual Impact: End-to-end ownership at the feature level — design, implementation, deployment, and the maintenance work that follows.
  • Educational Background: B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Preferred / Bonus Skills

  • Supply Chain Security Standards: Working familiarity with CVE, CVSS v3, EPSS, KEV (CISA), and SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX)
  • Scanner & Remediation Tooling: Direct experience with at least two of Snyk, Trivy, Grype, Dependabot, Renovate, Semgrep SCA, OSV-Scanner, or Dependency-Track.
  • Reachability Analysis: Exposure to reachability tooling (e.g., Semgrep) to prioritize fixes by exploitability rather than raw CVE count.
  • GitHub-at-Scale Automation: Experience driving changes across many repositories through GitHub Actions, Dependabot configuration, or custom bots.

The Experience
Salesforce is transforming the Developer Experience using AI - to change how software is designed, built, tested, secured, and operated. We're looking for an Architect to set the strategy and technical direction for our Internal Agentic Platform, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM Model Gateway, and Context Engineering capabilities.

This is a hands-on architecture role for a technical leader who can define a compelling platform experience and help deliver it in production. You'll shape how agents work, how they connect to tools and models, how they use enterprise knowledge, and how they support developers across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Your work will help teams adopt AI safely and effectively, improve developer productivity, and avoid solving the same platform problems independently.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Own the strategy and architecture for a powerful agentic platform experience that enables teams to build, compose, deploy, and operate agents across Salesforce. Set architecture and adoption direction for MCP, including server and client patterns, tool discovery, interoperability, identity, authorization, and lifecycle management.
  • Define reusable platform capabilities for agent orchestration, tool and skill integration, agent runtimes, state and memory, human oversight, evaluation, and production operations.
  • Set technical direction for agentic framework adoption, including the use of Mastra AI and LangChain/LangGraph. Guide framework integration and evolution while keeping the platform coherent, extensible, and adaptable to new approaches.
  • Establish patterns that help teams move from prototypes to dependable production agents, with clear paths for customization, evaluation, observability, and ongoing improvement.
  • Drive new AI-enabled developer experiences across the SDLC, including code understanding and generation, test creation, code review, debugging, modernization, documentation, and release or operational workflows.
  • Define how MCP fits into agent runtimes and the broader platform, enabling agents to connect to enterprise tools and systems through secure, governed, and reusable integrations.
  • Define the architecture and evolution of a secure, extensible LLM Model Gateway that provides consistent model access, policy enforcement, observability, resilience, and governance across providers and deployment types.
  • Drive a cost-effective model portfolio spanning small language models (SLMs) and large language models (LLMs). Evaluate when to use hosted, open-weight, fine-tuned, or specialized models for different workloads.
  • Develop ways to measure and improve model economics, including cost per successful task, token and context efficiency, retry rates, inference utilization, and the impact of model or routing changes.
  • Own the strategy for context engineering and enterprise knowledge management so agents can access relevant, grounded, and permission-aware information.
  • Guide the architecture of enterprise retrieval systems, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Graph RAG, and determine how they work with enterprise data, knowledge sources, and agent workflows.
  • Set shared standards for security, privacy, governance, reliability, observability, evaluation, and human oversight across agents, models, tools, and data.
  • Stay close to implementation by prototyping ideas, validating architecture through working systems, reviewing critical designs, and helping teams resolve technical tradeoffs.
  • Align engineering, product, security, data, and infrastructure partners around platform strategy, adoption, and delivery.
  • Communicate architectural decisions clearly, influence across teams, and mentor engineers and technical leaders.
  • Design complex systems where AI agents fit smoothly into human workflows, and ship secure, high-quality software with AI as a core part of your own development workflow. Build and maintain the shared system context that lets AI work accurately, and review code, whether written by people or AI, for correctness, quality, security, and performance.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 15+ years of experience designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems, developer platforms, AI platforms, or infrastructure services.
  • You have a track record of setting strategy and technical direction across teams, then carrying it through implementation and production operation.
  • You have strong expertise in agentic platform architecture and experience creating platform capabilities that make agent development and operation effective for application teams.
  • You have hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as Mastra AI and LangChain/LangGraph, including the ability to evaluate their tradeoffs and establish scalable platform patterns.
  • You have experience designing model gateways, inference platforms, model-serving systems, model orchestration layers, or equivalent shared services.
  • You have experience evaluating models against real workloads, with a practical understanding of quality, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost tradeoffs.
  • You are familiar with SLMs, LLMs, model routing, fine-tuning, quantization, inference optimization, or other ways to improve cost and performance.
  • You have experience building enterprise knowledge or retrieval systems using RAG, Graph RAG, search, or related approaches.
  • You have experience designing application programming interfaces (APIs) and extensible integration patterns. Familiarity with MCP or comparable tool and protocol ecosystems is a plus.
  • You have expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as identity and authorization, data platforms, retrieval and search, context management, workflow orchestration, platform security, or developer experience.
  • You understand software development workflows and how to assess whether AI capabilities improve developer experience, productivity, and engineering outcomes.
  • You use sound judgment around security, privacy, reliability, performance, and operational cost in fast-changing technical environments.
  • You have strong communication skills and the ability to build alignment across engineering, product, security, and business teams.
  • You bring a genuine AI-first approach to engineering. You use AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor to move faster and work across the stack, and you write precise, structured prompts that make AI output reliable, secure, and production-ready.
  • A related technical degree required.

title: Senior Solution Consultant (Global)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

「グローバルな知見とAIを駆使し、日本の変革を加速させる」

本ポジションは、日本のお客様とインドのGlobal Delivery Center (GDC) を結ぶ戦略的ハブとして、Salesforceを活用したビジネス変革を支援します。最大のミッションは、単なる言葉の通訳にとどまらず、日本側のシニアアーキテクトとペアを組み、案件内容やプロセスを技術的に理解した上で、GDCメンバーと共に「戦略・変革デザイン」「プロジェクト実行支援」「ガバナンス・最適化」といった幅広いサービスをデリバリーすることにあります。

日本固有のビジネスコンテキストと、GDCが持つ世界最高水準の技術力、グローバル標準手法であるSalesforce Professional Service Methodology（SPSM）、そして利用可能なAI Tool群を融合させ、お客様のROI（投資対効果）を最大化する「技術的・文化的ファシリテーター」としての役割を担います。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 日本側Architectとのペアリング遂行: 国内のシニアアーキテクトと常に連携し、案件の背景、個別の支援タスク、業務プロセス、および期待されるアウトプットの定義を深く理解する。
  • 技術的コンテキストの橋渡し: 成果物の内容や作成プロセス自体を技術的に把握し、GDCが作成するアウトプットが日本の顧客の品質基準に適合するよう、英語を用いて詳細な指示・レビューを行う。
  • 視覚的トランスレーション: 日本のお客様の要望（日本語・抽象的な表現）を、GDCが正確に実装できる具体的な技術仕様（図解、デモ、ロジカルな英語）へ変換して伝達する。
  • AI活用によるデリバリー加速: AIツールを駆使し、指示書の作成、ドキュメントの要約、成果物の一次レビューを効率的に行い、日本側アーキテクトの負担軽減とプロジェクト全体のスピード向上を図る。
  • 文化・ニュアンスの調整: 日本特有の商習慣や「行間」にある意図を、GDCに伝わりやすい明確なロジックへ変換し、多国籍チームにおける認識齟齬を未然に防ぐ。



You're Our Person If...

  • 実務経験: 3〜5年以上のエンタープライズ・システムにおけるコンサルティング、またはITシステム構築プロセスの実務経験（開発、設計、QA等）
  • プロセスとアウトプットの理解: 要件定義から設計・開発・テスト・移行に至る各フェーズで「何を作るべきか」「どう進めるべきか」というタスクレベルの深い理解
  • 言語能力:日本語: 流暢（日本のお客様や社内アーキテクトの意図を正確に汲み取れること）英語: ビジネスレベル（インドGDCのアーキテクトと、技術的な詳細やプロセスの改善について適切に英語で伝えられること）
  • 異文化適応力: 日本とインドのIT開発文化（ドキュメントの粒度、コミュニケーションスタイル等）の相違を前向きに捉え、そのギャップを埋める調整を楽しめる方
  • AIリテラシー: AIツール群を自身の業務（翻訳、要約、仕様作成、コードレビュー等）に積極的に活用し、生産性を高める意欲があること



日本のシニアアーキテクトと緊密なペアを組み、プロジェクトのタスクやプロセスの意図を正しく理解し、GDCへ正確かつ効率的に伝える実行支援を担います。

日本側アーキテクトのリードのもと、GDCと協力して以下の実務を支えます。

  • 戦略・変革支援の具体化: 業務プロセス改革や組織変革、システム領域変革（ITランドスケープ）における定義・実行のサポート。
  • プロジェクト実行支援: 要件定義のファシリテーション補佐、詳細設計の作成/レビューの仲介、開発・テストの品質管理、データ移行戦略の実行。
  • ガバナンスと最適化の運用: 設計品質の診断プロセスや承認フローの運用。既存環境の診断（ヘルスチェック）におけるGDCとの連携。
  • プロフェッショナルな調整力: 異なる文化・背景を持つチームの間に立ち、共通のゴールに向かって粘り強く、かつ柔軟に調整を行える方
  • 技術的背景を持つ理解者: 単なる「通訳」ではなく、IT構築の現場感覚を持ってアウトプットの質に責任を持てる方。
  • AIを武器にできる方: AIや新しいテクノロジーを積極的に取り入れ、よりスマートで効率的なブリッジ業務を体現したい方


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】

株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

私たちは「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。


【柔軟な働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】

  • ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
  • フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
  • 充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
  • ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。

Unleash Your Potential

title: Account Executive, Growth Market Sales
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Account Executive, Growth Market 
Our Growth Market Team is part of our wider Enterprise Sales Teams, focusing on working with exciting growth organizations. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with varied customers and personalized training and career opportunities.


Why Join Salesforce as an Account Executive?

This team is extremely tight knit; we celebrate our differences and wins and learn from losses. You’re joining our Ohana, and we’re all working towards the same goals.
This role is the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in all things Salesforce. You will get exposure to a range of internal teams and business units, so your overall knowledge of how we work and operate will grow very quickly.
We have a strong and tenured leadership team who come to work every day full of energy and looking for opportunities to support the team. We offer formal and informal training for all people coming into this role, and this will be entirely focused around your strengths and goals. We encourage 360 degree feedback, so you have the opportunity to take your own initiative and blaze your own trail.
 

Day to Day

  • Our Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and decision makers within their patch, and become naturals at helping customers realize value from their Salesforce investments.
  • You will use your new business development skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.
  • Close opportunities at assigned existing accounts and drive sales at new accounts
  • Drive sales within assigned segment (medium size business)
  • Acquire new logos within assigned territory
  • Speak to Salesforce offerings as they relate to the customer’s needs and engage other Salesforce resources as required
  • Manage high volume of accounts and sales

Who you are

We have an open mind in Growth Market and we’re not just looking for Account Executives who have experience in SaaS. If you have been in a quota carrying sales role looking after end-to-end sales processes, then we want to talk to you!
Embody a growth mindset – You’re thinking ahead and have a plan for yourself.
You're able to craft a point of view, hold an opinion, and build credibility as a ‘Trusted Adviser’ within your customers.
Self awareness is very important, and you must understand your ‘why’. You’re naturally curious and will be excited about the chance to absorb all Salesforce has to offer.
We don’t need you to have used Salesforce before, but it would have an advantage. A genuine passion for technology, disruption and innovation is also ideal.
Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

  • 5+ years of IT software sales experience
  • Business level of Korean and English language skills

Working at Salesforce

  • Working at Salesforce isn’t all about selling. It’s also about learning, and we heavily invest in you with a month-long immersion and onboarding, including: a week-long product bootcamp, mentorship program, weekly coaching and development programs.
  • Benefits
  • We are pioneers of the Pledge 1% model, providing product, grants and community service to those in need. We are proud to be#1 in PEOPLE's Top 50 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune’s Change the World list.
  • We provide every employee with 7 paid volunteer days off a year, and donation matching for all approved charitable donations.
  • We provide other world-leading benefits to all our employees, including;
  • Health, life insurance, retirement saving plan
  • Monthly wellness allowance
  • Flexible time off & leave policies
  • Parental benefits
  • Perks and discounts


------
Growth Market Account Executive
Growth Market 팀은 광범위한 엔터프라이즈 영업 팀의 일부이며, 흥미로운 성장 조직과 협력하는 데 중점을 둡니다. 다양한 고객과 함께 빠르게 변화하는 팀에서 일하고, 개인 맞춤형 교육 및 경력 개발 기회를 얻을 수 있습니다.


Salesforce Account Executive로 합류해야 하는 이유
우리 팀은 매우 긴밀하며, 서로의 차이점과 성공을 축하하고 실패로부터 배웁니다. 여러분은 우리의 ‘오하나(Ohana)’에 합류하게 되며, 우리는 모두 같은 목표를 향해 나아갑니다.
이 역할은 Salesforce의 모든 것을 경험할 수 있는 완벽한 기회입니다. 다양한 내부 팀과 사업 부문에 노출되어 우리의 업무 방식과 운영 방식에 대한 전반적인 지식을 빠르게 넓힐 수 있습니다.
우리는 매일 활력이 넘치고 팀을 지원할 기회를 찾는 강력하고 숙련된 리더십 팀을 보유하고 있습니다. 우리는 이 역할에 새로 합류하는 모든 사람에게 공식 및 비공식 교육을 제공하며, 이는 여러분의 강점과 목표에 완전히 집중될 것입니다. 우리는 360도 피드백을 장려하여 여러분이 주도적으로 자신의 길을 개척할 수 있도록 지원합니다.


일상 업무

  • Account Executive는 기존 고객 및 신규 리드와 소통하여 전체 Salesforce Customer 360 플랫폼을 판매합니다. 담당 지역 내 주요 팀원 및 의사 결정권자와 긍정적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 관계를 구축하고, 고객이 Salesforce 투자를 통해 가치를 실현하도록 돕는 데 능숙해집니다.
  • 따뜻한 리드와 화이트스페이스 영업을 통해 새로운 비즈니스 개발 기술을 활용하여 기회를 창출합니다.
  • 할당된 기존 계정에서 기회를 성사시키고 신규 계정에서 매출을 창출합니다.
  • 할당된 세그먼트(중견 기업) 내에서 매출을 주도합니다.
  • 할당된 지역 내에서 새로운 로고를 확보합니다.
  • 고객의 요구와 관련된 Salesforce 제품을 설명하고 필요한 경우 다른 Salesforce 리소스를 참여시킵니다.
  • 많은 계정 및 영업을 관리합니다.

어떤 분을 찾고 있나요
우리는 Growth Market에서 열린 마음을 가지고 있으며, SaaS 경험이 있는 Account Executive만 찾는 것은 아닙니다. 엔드 투 엔드 영업 프로세스를 담당하는 할당량 기반 영업 역할을 수행한 경험이 있다면, 우리는 여러분과 이야기하고 싶습니다!

성장 마인드를 구현합니다. 미래를 내다보고 자신을 위한 계획을 세웁니다. 자신의 관점을 만들고, 의견을 제시하며, 고객 내에서 ‘신뢰할 수 있는 조언자’로서 신뢰를 구축할 수 있습니다. 자기 인식이 매우 중요하며, 자신의 ‘왜(why)’를 이해해야 합니다. 자연스럽게 호기심이 많고 Salesforce가 제공하는 모든 것을 흡수할 기회에 흥분할 것입니다. Salesforce를 사용해 본 경험은 필수는 아니지만, 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 기술, 혁신 및 파괴적 혁신에 대한 진정한 열정이 있다면 더욱 좋습니다.
학위 또는 동등한 관련 경험이 필요합니다. 경험은 역할의 핵심 역량(예: 과외 리더십 역할, 군 경험, 자원 봉사 역할, 직장 경험 등)을 기반으로 평가됩니다.

  • 5년 이상의 IT 소프트웨어 영업 경험
  • 비즈니스 수준의 한국어 및 영어 능력

Salesforce 근무 환경
Salesforce에서 일하는 것은 단순히 판매하는 것만이 아닙니다. 학습도 중요하며, 우리는 한 달 간의 몰입형 온보딩을 통해 여러분에게 많은 투자를 합니다. 여기에는 1주일간의 제품 부트캠프, 멘토십 프로그램, 주간 코칭 및 개발 프로그램이 포함됩니다.


혜택

  • 우리는 도움이 필요한 사람들에게 제품, 보조금 및 지역 사회 봉사를 제공하는 Pledge 1% 모델의 개척자입니다. 우리는 PEOPLE의 ‘배려하는 50대 최고 기업’ 1위 및 Fortune의 ‘세상을 바꾸는 기업’ 목록에 이름을 올린 것을 자랑스럽게 생각합니다.
  • 우리는 모든 직원에게 연간 7일의 유급 자원 봉사 휴가를 제공하고, 승인된 모든 자선 기부에 대해 기부금 매칭을 제공합니다.
  • 우리는 모든 직원에게 다음과 같은 세계 최고 수준의 기타 혜택을 제공합니다.
  • 건강, 생명 보험, 퇴직 저축 계획
  • Monthly Wellness 수당

embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.

Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback. 


You'll work alongside a high-talent-density team that cares deeply about craft, performance, reliability, and user experience, and that raises the bar through collaboration, code review, and strong engineering principles. You'll make architecture decisions, solve meaningful system design challenges, and see your work land quickly with customers, without layers of approvals slowing you down. 


The Role 


The Brain team owns the intelligence layer behind Piper, our flagship AI SDR product for qualifying leads and booking meetings. Our team is responsible for building, maintaining, and upgrading the agents that power Piper to support new

capabilities and model releases. We own the system prompts, model configuration, context layer, evals, and harness that powers Piper behind the scenes.

You will work closely with product teams to build the products and features that allow our customers to bring their customer GTM strategy, CRM data, and guardrails together to deliver an on-brand, personalized, muilti-modal AI SDR

agent experience to their website and email.


You will work closely with the AI platform teams to build and maintain LLM evals that measure Piperʼs overall health, response quality, and ensure that those changes contribute to business outcomes like converting leads, booking meetings, and driving pipeline.


Who You Are 


Minimum of 5 years of experience working in product engineering or related fields.


Customer-centric thinking: have a deep connection of our customers' needs and how that translates to the experiences that we build for them. Much of your work will be tuning the agent to cater towards that, so you must be comfortable working backwards from a customer's preference and finding ways to capture human judgment as success criteria for an agent.


Product engineering and ownership. Strong full-stack fundamentals and proficiency in frontend and backend development. Ability to work independently and engage with product and domain experts, spot gaps, and own the ideas through to production. Agent fundamentals. You understand the core building blocks of agents: traces, context and tokens, tools, system prompts, models, latency and reasoning tradeoffs, MCP, etc. You know how to troubleshoot a LLM response and identify the source of the issue in the trace. You have an opinion on the strengths and weaknesses of different frontier models. You know what agents are and are not good for. Hands-on work with an LLM observability system, building or contributing to an eval system is a plus.




Nice to Have


Agentic development. Comfortable building alongside agents and utilizing coding agents effectively in your daily development. You can recognize poor quality code and writing produced by agents and know how to steer them towards a high-quality outcome on large tasks. You know how to use them to automate easy/repetitive tasks and build your domain expertise.


Experience building software for marketing, sales, or go-to-market teams, particularly integrations with Salesforce and other CRM platforms. Startup experience and rapid shipping. 


Why Join Qualified 


Foundational impact: Shape how our AI agents retrieve, reason, and answer, and the tooling every engineer here uses to build them. 


Lead real initiatives: Own significant projects end to end, with scope and 

influence that grow as you deliver. You'll own the platform as it scales, from retrieval to model providers to agent orchestration, and set the performance and reliability bar that grows with the company. 


AI as a core product surface: Turn new AI capabilities into dependable 

experiences that customers trust, with strong engineering around evaluation, observability, and iteration. 


High bar, low bureaucracy: Work with a team that values craft and decisive execution, where strong ideas win and shipping is the default.

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters

We are a newly formed, fast-growing team in Salesforce’s Chief Customer Officer (CCO) organization, within the Office of the CEO. We sit at the intersection of customer insight, pricing and packaging, field readiness, executive narrative, and go-to-market execution. We work directly with senior leaders across Product, Field, Pricing, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to frame the company’s most important strategic questions and drive them to decision.

We are hiring a Sr. Manager, Growth Planning to own how the company decides where to invest and holds itself to the results. You will build the business cases behind major growth investments and run the governance that tracks them from approval to delivered value.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Build the business cases for investments tied to identity, access management, and entitlement models, working with Product and Engineering to quantify how access and entitlement design affects packaging, adoption, cost-to-serve, and revenue.
  • Own the business case process for major growth and investment initiatives, including the revenue, cost, payback, and risk assumptions and the scenario models behind them. Set the standards and templates so proposals across Product, Field, and Pricing are comparable and decision-ready.
  • Run the governance cadence for planning and investment reviews. This covers the agenda, decision rights, escalation paths, and follow-through.
  • Track approved initiatives against committed targets. Report progress, variances, and benefits realization to executive leadership, and recommend course corrections.
  • Lead trade-off discussions with senior stakeholders and drive them to a clear decision without direct authority.
  • Partner with Finance, Sales, and Product to set, challenge, and align the assumptions and inputs behind each case and the broader plan.
  • Prepare executive materials and narratives for planning cycles and leadership reviews.
  • Build and mentor a small team of planning and analytics talent, and set the bar for rigor and quality.



Minimum Requirements

The Experience

Monitoring Cloud is seeking engineers to architect, implement, deliver, and operate the telemetry agents and instrumentation libraries that power observability at Salesforce scale.

Monitoring Cloud is an integral part of the Salesforce Infrastructure, providing the insights every development team relies on to detect and remediate incidents and keep Salesforce products highly available for our customers. This cloud owns the entire telemetry stack, from the agents that emit, collect, and ship telemetry to the large-scale backends that store it and serve low-latency queries. We support all the key pillars of telemetry (metrics, logs, traces, and events) at massive scale, built from a combination of open source and home-grown technologies architected from the ground up to run efficiently in the public cloud.

The Monitoring Agent team sits at the very front of that stack. We own every telemetry collection agent and instrumentation library at Salesforce: we instrument, collect, transform, and export logs, metrics, traces, and events across Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), GovCloud, and Agentforce/LLM services. Our work spans OpenTelemetry Collector pipelines, eBPF-based edge instrumentation, an OpAMP fleet-management control plane, agent-side anomaly detection, and instrumentation libraries embedded in thousands of services. These agents run on millions of hosts, so efficiency, reliability, and safe rollout are first-order design constraints.

We are looking to add engineers with experience building and owning distributed services who can step up and own big chunks of this vision. About the Team
The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce's own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.

  • Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.
  • Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings.
  • Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent.
  • Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents.
  • Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.



What it's like to join at this level: You'll be the go-to person for production on your platforms. You'll own how escalations work, swarm incidents alongside reliability engineers, shape how the team operates, and set the standard for processes, documentation, readiness, and reliability. You'll partner with reliability and engineering leaders, work with vendors, and raise the skills of every analyst around you.

Who thrives here: You've run production through hard days and stay calm when it matters. You see patterns across incidents and turn them into durable fixes. You teach naturally, communicate well with senior stakeholders, and favor automation over heroics.

What Are We Looking For?
As a Systems Specialist Lead, Data Foundations, you'll be the go-to expert for escalations across cases, investigations, and production events on Salesforce's enterprise data and analytics platforms. You'll be a frontline leader in incidents, swarming with our reliability engineers, who own incident response alongside Incident Command. You'll own how escalations work, how quickly and well we respond to and resolve requests, how satisfied our customers and partners are, readiness, root-cause quality, and the lightweight processes and reference material that support teams rely on. You'll mentor and guide analysts and senior analysts, and you'll work with engineering, reliability, vendors, and business leaders. You are an individual contributor and a technical and operational leader.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Own the escalation model for cases, intake, investigations, and SOPs across teams, vendors, and time zones: define paths, severity and priority criteria, handoffs, and the thresholds for pulling in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), and make sure escalations are worked to closure.
  • Set expectations with the SRE lead for how Specialists and SREs swarm incidents together: Specialists are the frontline and first connect, SREs own incident resolution, and Incident Command is an external role you work with. Make sure the case, intake, and stakeholder communication side of every major incident is covered, up to executives.
  • Analyze escalation trendlines (volume, repeat causes, time to engage, time to resolve) and turn them into reliability, staffing, and platform engineering priorities.
  • Partner with SREs on disaster recovery planning and tests for your platform area, bringing the support and readiness view.
  • Contribute case and intake learnings to post-incident reviews led by SREs, and make sure support follow-ups (SOPs, reference material, routing) get done.
  • Resolve complex declarative and code issues, and close RCAs with fixes that prevent recurrence.
  • Identify system, process, and technical-debt gaps, and recommend resolutions and priorities to leadership.
  • Contribute to design reviews and shape reliability practices, including Operational Readiness gates for releases.
  • Define monitoring, alerting, and self-healing automation with SRE and engineering partners.
  • Own SLA delivery and backlog health for your vertical or platform.
  • Refine, track, and improve the Intake + Investigation lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART). Set targets by severity and case type, report on them regularly, and drive improvements from the trends.
  • Track case and stakeholder satisfaction (CSAT, NPS): set up how feedback is collected, analyze themes, and turn them into process, staffing, and platform engineering improvements.
  • Hold yourself and the team to the same SLA and satisfaction targets, with L6 leads mentoring and challenging and L5s supporting.
  • Manage complex enhancement projects from inception to support transition, balancing multiple projects and priorities.
  • Apply advanced platform knowledge and intermediate coding (Apex, Python, SQL) to solve difficult issues and automate recurring work.
  • Own process engineering for your area: templates, process design, capture, and lifecycle (create, review, update, retire) for lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs). This is process design, not technical writing.
  • Set the standards and templates that other teams adopt, and make Platform Engineering's SRM inputs a required part of release readiness.
  • Request SRM inputs from Platform Engineering and create or manage them as needed.
  • Design runbooks and knowledge content for reuse, with automation and self-service where possible.
  • Own support playbook development and lifecycle for your area.
  • Manage vendor relationships and service levels, and work with scrum teams, product, and engineering as the operations liaison.
  • Build working relationships with business stakeholders and teams beyond your immediate group to advance shared initiatives.
  • Apply security and compliance policies in complex situations, and own implementation for your area.
  • Own technology compliance activities, audit and SOX evidence, and closure of findings.
  • Uphold the SDLC (Agile) and change, deployment, incident, and problem management processes.
  • Coach and mentor Systems Analysts and Senior Analysts, give constructive feedback to the manager, and raise the team's technical bar.
  • Teach new technology and business requirements across a global team.
  • Influence senior leaders on operational priorities and risk.
  • On-call and travel as required, subject to local regulations. Other related duties as required.


You're Our Person If...

  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
  • 5+ years of platform-specific development, implementation, or support experience in an enterprise IT environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce native functionality and best practices.
  • Intermediate knowledge of coding languages (Apex, Python, SQL).
  • Proven experience managing escalations across cases, investigations, and incidents across teams and time zones, including frontline incident response and knowing when to pull in reliability engineers.
  • Experience owning RCAs, and designing the processes, SOPs, and reference manuals for a platform or business process vertical.
  • Experience defining, tracking, and improving service level metrics (for example FRT, NRT, ART) and satisfaction measures (CSAT, NPS).
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships across engineering, product, and business teams.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical and senior audiences.
  • Ability to work independently with little supervision in a distributed, global team.
  • Certifications (achieved): Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201), Advanced Administrator (ADM-211), and Platform Developer I.


Even Better If...

  • Certifications: Data 360, Tableau, Platform Developer II, Platform App Builder, or other specialist or architect certifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Data 360, Agentforce, CRM Analytics, or Tableau.
  • Experience working with SRE practices, SLOs, and observability tooling.
  • Experience managing vendor or outsourced service delivery.
  • Experience in SOX-controlled environments.
  • Experience mentoring or leading teams through enablement programs.

The Experience Library team is part of the Digital Marketing Technology organization at Salesforce. We build and own a content authoring and rendering platform that powers marketing pages across salesforce.com. Our platform enables marketing teams to create high-quality, localized, and performant web experiences at scale, powering some of the highest-traffic pages in the Salesforce digital ecosystem.
We work across the full stack with a strong frontend focus on building modular component libraries, WordPress integrations, and a robust rendering layer serving global audiences. We embrace a "you build it, you own it" culture, where engineers are responsible for the quality, performance, and reliability of what they ship, from design to deployment and beyond.
Our team is at an exciting inflection point: actively integrating AI into our engineering workflows, running accelerated innovation initiatives, and expanding internationalization support to new global markets.

The Experience

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) to serve as a technical leader and frontend-focused full-stack domain expert on the Page Builder platform. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end architectural design, engineering roadmap, and development of high-impact, enterprise-scale web capabilities powering salesforce.com.
As a technical leader, you will set the engineering standard for the team, foster a culture of technical excellence, drive AI-first workflow innovations, and play a pivotal role in mentoring engineers across the organization.

  • Technical Vision & Strategy: Help drive the technical roadmap for web platform development within Digital Marketing Technology, with a focus on scalable authoring pipelines, component libraries, CMS architecture (WordPress/Contentful), and high-performance rendering engines.

  • Scalability & Web Performance: Architect and maintain resilient, accessible, and performant web systems, optimizing Core Web Vitals, caching strategies, CDN configurations (e.g., Akamai), and global rendering infrastructure.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, AI Platform Engineers, Principal Engineers, and cross-functional teams to define requirements, decompose complex initiatives, manage dependencies, and deliver reusable workflows.
  • Mentorship & Quality Standards: Foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. Drive code and design reviews, establish automated testing and CI/CD best practices, and actively mentor MTS and SMTS engineers through technical coaching and pair programming.

You're Our Person If...

  • Experience: 10+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on large-scale, complex frontend and full-stack web applications.
  • Frontend Mastery: Deep expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/Sass/Tailwind, and modern frontend frameworks (React preferred; Web Components, Vue, or Angular).
  • Backend & Node.js: Extensive experience with Node.js and building scalable backend/BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) architectures supporting client application rendering.
  • CMS Architecture: Proven experience architecting and integrating enterprise Content Management Systems (particularly WordPress and/or Contentful) and designing dynamic CMS-driven frontend rendering pipelines.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Solid understanding of public cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and experience deploying scalable, distributed frontend services, CDN edge caching, and build pipelines.
  • API Design & Security: Deep knowledge of RESTful and GraphQL API design, web security best practices, and state management at enterprise scale.
  • Test Automation & MLOps/DevOps: Advanced knowledge of testing methodologies and frameworks (Jest, Cucumber, Selenium, Cypress) and modern deployment/monitoring practices.
  • Leadership & Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence cross-functional roadmaps, troubleshoot complex production issues, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related STEM field.

Even Better If…

Salesforceの代表的な営業ポジションであるAccount Executiveは、アカウント攻略という視点で数字を最大化させるための営業スキルを学べる一方、製品のSpecialist AEでは担当するセグメントのビジネスをどうしたら成長させられるかという視点が求められるため、目の前の商談をCloseするための営業スキルを磨くことはもちろん、Generalistとしての視点でビジネスを進めていく経験ができます。Salesforceという大きな会社の中でこのような経験ができることは、これまでの営業職とは違った形で皆さんのキャリアアップに大きく貢献できるポジションとなっています。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 主に東京エリアを中心とした大手企業を担当Responsibilities:世界No.1 CRMソリューションプロバイダーにおけるECソリューションを、マーケティング部門、インサイドセールス部門、チャネルセールス部門、パートナー様など協調しながら新規顧客開拓、既存顧客の深耕を推進をし、自身の売上目標（個人業績）の達成を目指していただきます。
  • B2C/B2BのプラットフォームであるCommerce Cloudを直販形式で提案及び販売いただきます。
  • Salesforceの他のソリューションの理解を含め、顧客ニーズの実現に合わせた提案を実施いただきます。
  • 製品ではなくサービスを顧客に提供しますので、製品の出荷・納品に労力を費やすことは無く、顧客の成功に向けた提案に集中ができます。
  • 提案先の多くはCxO、役員クラスで、経営及び事業戦略における課題解決に向けた提案を推進いただきます。
  • 製品のスペシャリストでありながら、セールスリードの職務を遂行いただきます。
  • 担当テリトリーの中で年間の販売戦略の策定及びセールスプレイの実行頂きます。
  • キーパートナーとなるデジタルエージェンシー、システムインテグレーター、フルフィルメント/物流パートナーなどと協働した提案活動を進めることがあります。

Even Better If...
