  • ECソリューションの販売経験
  • 年間目標達成経験及び表彰経験


The Experience
Salesforce Commerce Cloud is looking for a Sales Executive, mainly covering the Tokyo area, as we expand our business in Japan. Using a direct sales approach with new and existing customers, you will make proposals that grow clients' businesses, starting from eCommerce and grounded in an understanding of their business. Your counterparts will mainly be business leaders such as executives and directors, so you can carry out sales activities with a strong consulting element.

What is a Specialist AE?
The Account Executive is a signature sales position at Salesforce. While it teaches you the sales skills to maximize results from an account-conquest perspective, a product Specialist AE is expected to think about how to grow the business of the segment you cover. This means you will sharpen the sales skills to close the deal in front of you, and you can also gain experience driving the business with a Generalist's perspective. Having this kind of experience within a large company like Salesforce makes this a position that can contribute greatly to your career advancement in a way that differs from previous sales roles.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Cover mainly large enterprises in the Tokyo area. Responsibilities: Work with the marketing, inside sales, and channel sales teams, partners, and others to drive new customer acquisition and deepen existing customer relationships with EC solutions from the world's No.1 CRM solution provider, aiming to achieve your own sales target (individual performance).
  • Propose and sell Commerce Cloud, a B2C/B2B platform, through a direct sales model.
  • Make proposals tailored to realizing customer needs, including an understanding of Salesforce's other solutions.
  • Because you provide customers with services rather than products, you will not spend effort on shipping or delivering products, and can focus on proposals for customer success.
  • Many of your proposal targets are CxO and executive-level leaders, and you will drive proposals that solve challenges in management and business strategy.
  • Perform the duties of a sales lead while being a product specialist.
  • Develop the annual sales strategy within your assigned territory and execute sales plays.

  • Customer-first mindset with a strong commitment to budget, and active in your work
  • Not tied to conventional ways, with a sense for adopting new approaches
  • Have established and practice your own methods for finding opportunities, prioritizing, and running the sales process to reach goals
  • Direct sales experience carrying an individual quota
  • Experience selling enterprise software

  • Drive cross functional execution to get things done

You are a design authority who is highly skilled at evaluating technical trade-offs, reviewing specifications, and guiding development teams plus experience delivering within regulated environments (privacy, consent, data integrity, and validation).

The Experience

Are you a performance leader who still loves the details? A systems performance expert? A builder of teams and of systems? Want to be part of something big? How about owning the performance of the distributed database technology that is powering growth of the Salesforce Platform across the globe? SalesforceDB is the transactional database behind Salesforce CRM. It runs more than 1.1 trillion transactions per month on thousands of database instances.

The Salesforce Database team is fast-paced and highly collaborative, and works across all areas of our distributed transactional database technology stack. We are seeking a Senior Director to own the SDB Performance technology line: the strategy, the organization, and the results that drive Salesforce DataBase.

You set direction on a year-plus horizon and you are accountable for it. You craft and deliver the V2MOM for the performance portfolio. You are a subject-matter expert in how a large distributed database behaves in production, and you build the managers and principal engineers who turn that expertise into shipped improvements. You are comfortable making hard calls on priority, resourcing, and trust, and you stand behind the outcomes.

Our performance organization partners closely with database and storage system developers, query processing engineers, application performance engineers, infrastructure engineers, and our analytics team to deliver all the pieces that add up to high performance in production at scale. Your organization's improvements ship across the whole production fleet every release, and some of our work is published at database research conferences such as CIDR. We are a high-performing team with high standards: we value integrity, rigor, and continuous learning.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

* Own the SDB Performance technology line. Craft and deliver the V2MOM for that portfolio, on a planning horizon of a year or more
* Set the direction for performance and scalability across the database engine, storage service, and query processing, and bring peer leadership along to see it through
* Be accountable for architecture: own the architectural decisions of the performance organization, and hold a consistent architecture and design process with partner clouds
* Own performance qualification of SalesforceDB releases, and deliver a record of successful performance capabilities across release qualification, production performance, capacity management, and query and systems optimization
* Lead benchmarking and modeling that guide hardware selection and capacity planning for the fleet, and the telemetry, dashboards, and analysis that show how the production fleet performs against its targets
* Hold the organization to trust standards, including scalability, service health, and the performance plans behind every release. Put proactive plans in place for systemic performance issues and technical debt
* Drive a production-first culture of service ownership. Personally coordinate performance-related production incident response within the cloud, and defuse cross-cloud performance issues on behalf of the database
* Make the hard resourcing decisions that keep the portfolio on its commitments, and shift teams as business priorities move
* Stay close to teams and customers who feel database performance, and use that insight to change what we build and how we operate
* Lead a collection of teams that make up the performance portfolio. This role manages other engineering managers
* Develop talent from Manager through Director, and coach engineers from early career through principal
* Build a high-performing, inclusive, geographically distributed organization. Motivate your teams and peer leaders. Share bad news early, solve the problems you can solve, and escalate when scope requires it
* Be the partner senior leaders in other clouds call when performance, capacity, or release risk is on the table. Build durable relationships with directors, senior directors, VPs, and the architects who support this area, and keep those architects informed and empowered

You're Our Person If…

* BS or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Subject-matter expertise in the performance of large-scale databases, storage, or distributed systems
* Proven record of owning a technology portfolio and delivering successful services or capabilities across multiple releases, on a year-plus horizon
* 10+ years of engineering management experience, including 5+ years managing other managers, and a track record of developing both managers and senior individual contributors
* 15+ years of experience in performance engineering or software engineering on databases, storage, or distributed systems, including 5+ years leading performance, scalability, or release-qualification teams
* Performance engineering background on systems software, ideally databases, storage, or distributed systems, with strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, concurrency, memory management) and the technical depth to engage on designs and code in Java or C/C++
* Hands-on experience with load, benchmark, and regression testing, ideally for multi-tenant workloads at scale, and with root cause analysis of performance and scalability problems in complex distributed systems
* Strong SQL and performance data analysis (CPU, latency, throughput, per-tenant resource use)
* Accountability for architecture and for trust outcomes, not only for a single team's sprint
* Strong judgment on prioritization, resourcing, and when to escalate
* Excellent communication across database, storage, infrastructure, application performance, and analytics teams: you can set a vision, tell the truth about risk, and bring peer leaders with you
* Integrity, high energy, and a growth mindset: you report what the data shows, seek feedback, and keep learning, with a collaborative style

Even Better If…

* MS or PhD in databases or distributed systems
* Deep knowledge of database internals: optimizer, query execution and optimization, storage, transactions, concurrency control, memory management
* Experience with performance workloads, system benchmarks, release qualification, and production performance investigation
* Splunk or similar telemetry, dashboards, and fleet-scale performance management
* Systems programming experience (C/C++ or Java), profiling, JVM tuning, and heap dump analysis
* SQL, Linux, data analysis and visualization, and experimental design
* Statistical analysis, benchmarking, and capacity modeling
* Operating system and network fundamentals: processes, threads, memory, file systems, storage, TCP/IP
* Cloud platforms and infrastructure (AWS, GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes
* Experience leading engineering organizations through V2MOM planning, agile delivery, service ownership, and incident response

  • Proven Performer: You have a history of consistently overachieving sales quotas and experience managing complex, seven-figure software deals.

  • Excellent Communicator: You have outstanding presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and business audiences.
  • Technically Savvy: You are proficient with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and other business tools. A Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience is preferred.
  • Company Builder: You are always on the lookout for great talent to help us continue building one of the best companies in the world.

한국 전략 고객을 담당하는 전담 세일즈 리더로서, 디지털 네이티브 분야 상위 기업의 성장을 이끌게 됩니다. 이 역할은 가시성이 높은 포지션으로, 한국을 대표하는 기업들과 깊이 있는 전략적 파트너십을 구축하고, Tableau의 분석 플랫폼을 전사적으로 도입하도록 지원하여 디지털 전환을 가속화합니다.

  • 경영진 관계 구축: 고객 조직 전반에서 C-레벨과 탄탄한 관계를 구축하고 유지하며, 고객의 데이터 및 분석 여정에서 신뢰받는 어드바이저 역할을 수행합니다.
  • 전 단계 영업: 기회 발굴부터 계약 체결까지 전체 영업 사이클을 주도하며, 복잡한 파이프라인을 능숙하게 관리하고 대기업의 조달 프로세스를 원활히 진행합니다.
  • 부서 간 협업 총괄: 세일즈 엔지니어, 커스터머 석세스 매니저 및 기타 전문가로 구성된 가상 어카운트 팀 간의 협업을 이끌어 설득력 있는 제품 데모, 평가, 종합 솔루션을 제공합니다.
  • 파이프라인 및 예측: Salesforce(CRM)에서 모든 고객 및 거래 정보를 꼼꼼하게 관리·추적하고, 파이프라인과 예측을 정확하게 정기적으로 보고합니다.

Roadmap and Solution Ownership

CSG Data & Insights Analystは、CSG内の特定の部門に固定されず、CSG全体を横断して支援するポジションです。チーム内のBusiness Partner（CSG各部門のリーダーの参謀役）や、営業戦略・財務・オペレーション・イネーブルメント（人材育成）など多様な部門との連携を主導しながら、お客様のSalesforce活用促進・解約リスクの最小化というCSGの重要な目標の達成に貢献します。

本ポジションは単なるレポーティング担当ではありません。Customer Successのビジネスモデル・業務プロセス・KPIと関係者（Stakeholder）の状況を理解したうえで、取り組むべきビジネス上の問いを自ら設定します。そして、データの収集・分析や分析用のデータマート・ダッシュボードの整備を通じて、意思決定を動かすInsightを届けることが求められます。戦略をビジネスの現場で実現することに情熱を持ち、周囲とのコラボレーションを楽しめる方を歓迎します。


What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Problem Framing：Customer Successのビジネスモデル・KPIとStakeholderの状況を踏まえ、取り組むべきビジネス上の問いと分析の優先度を主体的に定める
  • Insight Generation：お客様のSalesforce活用促進・製品利用量（Consumption）・解約リスクに関わる動向をデータで分析し、具体的な改善提案に落とし込む
  • Decision Support：Business Partnerと対等な立場で連携し、CSGのリーダー陣との議論、営業戦略部門との連携、経営層の意思決定といった場面で必要となるInsightを迅速に届ける
  • Analytics Foundation：分析手法・プロセスの継続的な改善に加え、AIによるデータ活用の広がりも見据え、データ品質の確認・データ定義の整理・アクセス管理などのデータガバナンスの整備にも、関係部門と連携しながら取り組む

You're Our Person If...


  • 経験：データを用いて事業課題の分析や意思決定の支援を行う業務（例：経営企画・事業企画、営業企画、データアナリストなど）における5年以上の実務経験があり、Customer SuccessまたはSaaSのビジネスモデル・業務プロセスへの理解がある
  • テクニカルスキル：SQLによるデータ抽出・集計の実務経験に加え、BIツール（Tableau等）でのエグゼクティブ向けダッシュボード構築、CRM（Salesforce等）・クラウドDWH（Snowflake等）のデータを活用した分析、Excel / Google Sheetsでの定量分析・財務モデリングのうち、複数の実務経験がある

Join Salesforce’s Marketing M&A Strategy & Integration team and help shape how acquired companies become part of Salesforce’s business and go-to-market ecosystem.

In this role, you will support marketing due diligence, develop go-to-market strategies, and help drive the integration of acquired businesses. You will work closely with Corporate Development, Marketing, Sales, Product, Finance, and acquired company leadership to evaluate opportunities, develop integration plans, and execute key initiatives.

This is a highly cross-functional role that combines strategic thinking, business analysis, and hands-on execution. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and eager to build expertise across the M&A lifecycle.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Support marketing due diligence for potential acquisitions, evaluating marketing organizations, GTM strategies, programs, budgets, pipeline performance, and operational capabilities.
  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative analyses to assess marketing performance, identify risks, and evaluate opportunities for growth.
  • Synthesize findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready diligence materials.
  • Support the development and execution of go-to-market strategies for acquired companies, including positioning, product launches, demand generation, and sales enablement.
  • Own assigned marketing integration workstreams, coordinating deliverables, milestones, risks, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, Product, Finance, Corporate Development, and acquired company teams to align priorities and drive integration activities.
  • Support marketing operating model decisions, resource planning, integration investments, and identification of potential synergies.
  • Identify integration risks and recommend mitigation strategies while balancing Salesforce priorities with the acquired company’s existing business and GTM motion.
  • Develop and maintain integration plans, executive updates, milestone trackers, and decision-support materials.
  • Coordinate cross-functional meetings, document decisions, manage action items, and drive accountability for key deliverables.
  • Identify opportunities to improve and standardize Marketing M&A processes, tools, and integration frameworks.
  • Manage competing priorities across multiple acquisitions in a fast-paced, evolving environment.



You're Our Person If...

  • Experience in marketing, GTM strategy, business operations, or a related function.
  • Understanding of enterprise software business models and how Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success work together to drive growth.
  • Familiarity with marketing functions such as product marketing, demand generation, events, communications, or marketing operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex business issues and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Experience working with financial and operational metrics, budgets, and business performance data.
  • Ability to translate detailed analyses into clear insights and recommendations for different audiences.
  • Interest in mergers and acquisitions, corporate strategy, and business integration.

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in AI simulation environments like eVerse, our simulation and agent-training environment; the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which powers Agentforce reasoning capabilities; and other AI systems that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. We also continue to publish at the world's top AI conferences, open source influential research, and collaborate with leading academic institutions. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Interns for Summer 2027 who want to help build the next generation of Enterprise AI. This is not a traditional research internship. You will work like a founder within Salesforce: exploring high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, and seeing how ideas are validated with customers and turned into production-ready solutions. You will have the freedom to propose and explore new ideas, alongside mentors and research scientists, with access to Salesforce's global customer and product ecosystem. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, bring energy and focus to their work, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this internship offers a unique opportunity to do research with global impact.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Collaborate with research scientists and engineers on a project focused on real-world product impact, with the opportunity to publish your work at top-tier conferences.
  • Explore research directions with the potential to transform Enterprise AI.
  • Help turn promising ideas into zero-to-one AI product prototypes.
  • Build models, agents, and AI systems for real-world enterprise use.
  • Learn how research partners with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to bring solutions to market.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have a strong publication record at top AI venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ACL, EMNLP) and/or experience building AI research into real-world systems.
  • You have experience with Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or DeepSpeed.
  • You are motivated by real-world impact and care about seeing your research leave the lab and reach users at scale.
  • You bring expertise in one or more core focus areas:
    • Agentic AI and Reasoning: LLM-powered agents, reinforcement learning (RL), reasoning and planning, autonomous workflows, computer use agents, deep research agents, and coding agents.
    • Multimodal and Computer Vision: Vision-language models, video understanding, and multimodal AI agents.
    • Speech Intelligence: Voice intelligence, text-to-speech/automatic speech recognition, and low-latency audio processing.
    • Core Modeling and Post-Training: Pre-training and post-training techniques including RLHF and direct preference optimization, model distillation, evaluation, and time series modeling.
  • You can conduct research with guidance from mentors, and you are ready to grow toward independence and translate ideas into impactful systems.



Even Better If...

  • You are a PhD or MS candidate in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
  • You have experience building and scaling ML models for real-world applications.
  • You have strong programming skills (competitive programming, e.g., ACM-ICPC, or open source experience).
  • You are thoughtful about responsible AI, trust, and the real-world impact of the systems you build.
  • You are a fantastic problem solver, able to tackle challenges the world hasn't solved before.
  • You have excellent written and spoken communication skills.
  • You collaborate effectively with teammates.

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Engineering at Qualified

Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We're building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.


Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup—backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback, without layers of approvals slowing you down.


The Role

Product Core builds the foundational product systems everything depends on: identifying prospects, scheduling and routing meetings, synchronizing data with calendars and go-to-market platforms, executing workflows, and supporting enterprise authentication. We also enable customers and partners to extend the product through public APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations. These capabilities power critical parts of the customer journey and have a meaningful impact on conversion, revenue, and customer trust.


The team also builds the data, context, and execution capabilities behind our agentic product experiences, including meeting preparation, routing investigation, and product explainability.


As an engineer on Product Core, you'll operate as a technical leader: leading complex initiatives from early design through production, shaping architecture, writing substantial production code, influencing technical direction, and helping other engineers do their best work.


What You'll Do

  • Lead complex product initiatives from an ambiguous problem through technical design, implementation, launch, and ongoing ownership
  • Build reliable meeting-booking, calendaring, routing, and workflow experiences that directly affect customer conversion and revenue
  • Build and evolve integrations with CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, collaboration, calendaring, and data-enrichment platforms
  • Build intuitive public APIs and reliable webhooks that let customers and partners extend the product
  • Design for the realities of third-party systems: API limits, OAuth credentials, inconsistent data, retries, synchronization, and partial failures
  • Advance AI-assisted capabilities such as meeting preparation, routing investigation, and explanations of product behavior
  • Improve the scalability, observability, security, and supportability of critical production systems, and own difficult customer issues to their root cause
  • Raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, design and code reviews, and mentorship

Who You Are

  • A track record of independently delivering complex SaaS capabilities from design through launch and ongoing operation
  • Strong full-stack skills, with particular depth in backend systems, APIs, relational data models, and background processing
  • Experience building or operating integrations with complex third-party platforms
  • Sound technical judgment around reliability, data integrity, security, and incremental system evolution
  • Excellent debugging skills across application, integration, and data boundaries
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: you influence architecture and execution beyond your immediate workstream
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity: you can frame problems, propose solutions, and align others
  • Product-minded: you care about UX and customer outcomes, not just implementation
  • Experience with modern web frameworks (Rails/React/Postgres/AWS is a plus; adaptability matters most)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM, marketing automation, scheduling, routing, enrichment, or workflow products
  • Familiarity with OAuth, webhooks, synchronization pipelines, rate-limited APIs, or eventual consistency
  • Experience with enterprise identity systems such as SSO, SAML, or SCIM
  • Experience building production AI or LLM applications, agent tooling, or explainability features

Why Join Qualified

  • Own systems that move revenue: Meeting booking, routing, and workflows sit directly in the customer conversion path. When they get better, customers win more deals.
  • Integration problems with real depth: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, sync, and partial failure: the hard, interesting problems of connecting enterprise systems at scale.

We are looking for a Vice President of Product Management to join Emerging Technology within Salesforce's Digital Enterprise Technology (DET) organization. As a member of the Emerging Technology leadership team, you will shape product strategy, build and lead the product management team, and translate emerging technologies into measurable value for Salesforce as Customer Zero and for our external customers.

Your portfolio will span experimentation programs that improve AI agents and support product-led growth; tools and shared-context capabilities that help employees build and deploy software more effectively; and customer-facing experiences across web, onboarding, self-service, and in-product surfaces. You will partner across Salesforce to identify opportunities, move quickly from ideas to working products, and use evidence to guide continued investment and improvement.

This role combines direct leadership of product managers with cross-functional leadership of flexible, mission-focused pods. Working with engineering, design, data, and business partners, you will help assemble teams around specific outcomes and adapt their composition as priorities evolve. Product ownership and delivery responsibilities will vary by initiative, requiring clear agreements and strong partnerships across organizational boundaries.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Set product strategy and priorities. Translate customer needs, business goals, and emerging technology opportunities into a clear portfolio strategy and actionable roadmaps. Make deliberate choices about where to experiment, invest, scale, or stop.
  • Build and lead a strong product management team. Hire, coach, and develop product managers who combine customer understanding, technical fluency, sound judgment, and a commitment to measurable outcomes. Build a culture of ownership, curiosity, and continuous learning.
  • Lead through flexible, cross-functional pods. Partner with functional leaders to bring together the capabilities each mission requires. Establish clear outcomes, decision rights, and responsibilities, and help teams form, adapt, and transition as work evolves.
  • Use experimentation to drive continuous improvement. Lead programs that test hypotheses, evaluate results, and turn learning into incremental improvements in agent performance and product-led growth. Partner with experimentation platform and data teams to apply appropriate methods, reliable measurement, and clear success criteria.
  • Accelerate software creation for builders across Salesforce. Shape tools and workflows that help engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders use AI and coding tools to develop and deploy software. Prioritize the needs of our core builder and pod community while creating capabilities that can serve a broader employee population.
  • Reduce coordination overhead through shared context. Develop product capabilities that make relevant requirements, decisions, knowledge, and work visible and usable across people, teams, and agents. Help builders spend less time reconstructing context and managing handoffs, and more time delivering useful software.
  • Deliver and improve customer-facing experiences. Partner with other Salesforce organizations on experiences spanning discovery, onboarding, self-service, and ongoing product use. Establish an appropriate ownership model for each initiative and align teams around customer value, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Connect Customer Zero learning to broader product opportunities. Use Salesforce's internal experience to surface customer needs, validate approaches, and inform the wider product portfolio. Communicate strategy, evidence, and tradeoffs clearly to executives, partners, and customers.

  • Product leadership and organizational development. A record of setting product direction, delivering meaningful customer and business outcomes, and hiring and developing strong product managers.

What is a Solution Engineer?

Also known as a "Pre-Sales Engineer" or "Sales Consultant," the Solution Engineer presents our product offerings to prospects and customers, builds confidence in our technology, and helps remove technical objections throughout the sales cycle. To do this, Solution Engineers draw on their technical and sales skills to gather business requirements, develop a technical sales strategy, and configure and demonstrate solutions that deliver business value.

Specialist Solution Engineer

Are you a technically minded, curious communicator who loves turning data into clear, compelling stories? As a Specialist Solution Engineer, you'll be the subject matter expert for Tableau and its family of products, including Tableau Cloud, Tableau Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics. You'll help customers across LATAM become more data-driven by showing how a trusted, governed semantic foundation turns data into decisions. You'll work side by side with Account Executives and account-team Solution Engineers to bring the value of Analytics to every conversation.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll support the technical sales cycle for Analytics, from discovery and storytelling demos to hands-on workshops, showing customers the "why" and the "what." You'll listen closely to business and data needs, then demo how Tableau helps customers define metrics and business rules once and reuse them in governed, trusted analytics. You'll show how analytics interoperability across Tableau Cloud, Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics works, and how recent innovations such as Tableau Knowledge, Tableau Studio, and Tableau Semantics fit the customer's existing data stack. You'll also act as an evangelist for Analytics with internal teams, helping them position Tableau with confidence.

Your Impact

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand each customer's business goals and challenges throughout the sales cycle
  • Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders by understanding their data and analytics strategy and identifying the right Tableau solution
  • Run discovery sessions and workshops with business users to define and build solution prototypes
  • Build and deliver customized demos that prove business value, including semantic models (Tableau Semantics, Published Data Sources) and analytics interoperability across Tableau Cloud, Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics
  • Present the value of Tableau clearly to business users, managers, and leaders
  • Demo and position Tableau's latest innovations, such as Tableau Knowledge and Tableau Studio, and show how they fit with the customer's existing data stack
  • Contribute technical responses to RFPs/RFIs
  • Enable the broader Solution Engineering team and adjacent teams to position Analytics within the Salesforce portfolio, through webinars, best practices, and knowledge sharing
  • Share customer feedback with the Product and GTM teams
  • Manage several customer engagements at once across LATAM, prioritizing with the sales team
  • Keep growing your expertise in Tableau, CRM Analytics, and the Salesforce platform
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel as needed


What we're looking for

We're seeking a proactive, collaborative professional with presales or technical experience in the software/IT industry or as an end user of analytics tools. You bring solid technical knowledge and hands-on expertise in data visualization/analytics or BI.

  • Experienced: 3+ years in technical pre-sales, consulting, or analytics roles, and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or equivalent experience
  • Technically strong: Hands-on experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, or similar BI tools (Power BI, Looker). Experience analyzing data, identifying trends, and building visualizations. Python and/or JavaScript is a plus
  • Specialized knowledge: Familiarity with data modeling, semantic layers, and data warehouse concepts. Experience building demos or proofs of concept is a plus
  • Strong communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication, and the ability to present in person and online to diverse audiences
  • Languages: English and Spanish required
  • Sales-minded: Able to support the sales team with business value articulation and product positioning
  • Creative: A mindset that looks for new ways to solve customer problems and bring fresh ideas to customers and the team
  • Organized: Strong time management to run multiple projects and sales cycles in parallel
  • Team player: Committed to team goals as well as individual ones


How you differentiate yourself

  • Salesforce certifications (Tableau Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist, CRM Analytics, Administrator)
  • Experience with semantic layers or metrics layers (Tableau Semantics, Published Data Sources, dbt, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, etc.)
  • Prior experience as a Salesforce power user or admin

The Experience


AI is changing how work gets done, and the winners will be the platforms where people and AI agents collaborate natively, not chatbots bolted onto legacy tools. Slack is that platform: the System of Engagement where people, AI agents, data and business apps come together in one flow of work.

We're growing our Australian Commercial team to meet surging demand from fast-moving businesses that are moving from experimenting with AI to putting it to work. You'll own your patch, build your pipeline and help shape how growing Australian companies work with AI.


What You'll Actually Be Doing...


  • Own the full sales cycle across a portfolio of Commercial accounts, from prospecting through to close, and drive Annual Contract Value growth
  • Run a high-velocity pipeline: generate your own opportunities, qualify quickly and move deals through shorter, faster sales cycles
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders and department heads. Understand their challenges and connect Slack's agentic platform to outcomes they care about, like faster decisions, less tool sprawl and more productive teams
  • Land and expand: win the first team or use case, then grow Slack's footprint across the business
  • Work with Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and partners to bring deals over the line, and with legal, security and procurement where needed
  • Build clear account plans and forecast accurately
  • Pass customer feedback back to our product teams to help shape Slack's future in Australia

You're Our Person If...


  • Experience building a compelling business case, with ROI as a core element, and winning buy-in from multiple stakeholders
  • Experience working alongside Customer Success, Solution Engineering and partners to close deals
  • The ability to explain AI and agentic concepts in terms of business value to both technical and non-technical audiences. No engineering background required
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to engage senior decision-makers
  • Sharp commercial instincts: accurate forecasting, strong pipeline management and a genuine commitment to customers' success
  • Real curiosity about where agentic AI is heading and how it changes the way teams work

Even Better If...


  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, ideally in a Commercial, Mid-Market or similar segment, with a record of consistently hitting or exceeding quota
  • Proven success managing a high volume of deals at once. This means balancing new business prospecting, expansion and renewals while keeping your pipeline disciplined

descriptionHtml:

The Experience

Help build the next generation of AI-powered engineering. Join our AI-native Academy as an early-career software engineer to solve real production challenges, build intelligent automation and strengthen system reliability. With hands-on guidance from a senior mentor, you’ll combine software development with production support experience, building the skills to grow into broader product and platform engineering roles.

You’ll investigate support cases, troubleshoot production issues and participate in support rotations—gaining firsthand insight into how complex systems work and where they can improve. Your mandate goes beyond resolving individual issues: you’ll build software, AI agents and tools that eliminate recurring manual work and prevent problems from returning.

Your projects could include agentic Tier 1/2 case automation, automated access workflows, technical knowledge retrieval, log analysis and system hardening. You’ll write, test, review and deploy code, with opportunities to own improvements from identifying the problem to measuring the result.

As you demonstrate strong engineering skills and measurable impact, you’ll have opportunities to graduate into core product engineering teams, based on your readiness and business needs. It’s a chance to learn through practical ownership, deliver meaningful improvements and build a foundation for your software engineering career.

What You'll do

  • Investigate and resolve support cases, production defects, access issues and integration failures.
  • Build automation for recurring tasks such as access requests, case responses, log analysis, troubleshooting and maintenance.
  • Develop AI agents and workflows that help classify cases, retrieve relevant knowledge and execute approved actions with appropriate safeguards.
  • Identify root causes and improve code, monitoring, tests and documentation to prevent recurring incidents.
  • Write, test, review and deploy maintainable software using established engineering practices.
  • Participate in incident response and scheduled support or on-call rotations, with training and guidance appropriate to your experience.
  • Work with senior mentors and product teams to understand systems, prioritize improvements and deliver changes safely.
  • Measure the impact of your work through reduced manual effort, fewer repeat issues, faster resolution and improved reliability.



What You'll bring

  • 3+ yrs of programming exp in at least one language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript or Go.
  • An understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, testing, version control and debugging.
  • An ability to investigate problems using logs, error messages and system behavior.
  • Curiosity about automation, AI-assisted development and reliable production systems.
  • Clear communication, a collaborative approach and a willingness to ask questions and learn from feedback.
  • A degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



Helpful Experience

  • Building scripts, internal tools or workflow automation.
  • Salesforce platform working knowledge preferably with Salesforce admin certification & APEX hands on experience - or desire to obtain certification.
  • Working with cloud platforms, databases, CI/CD pipelines or monitoring tools.
  • Developing or integrating AI agents, large language models or knowledge retrieval systems.
  • Supporting enterprise applications or investigating production incidents.
  • Applying secure coding practices, access controls and audit logging.



We welcome evidence of your skills from internships, coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions or professional experience. The scope and independence expected will reflect the level of the role.

How You’ll grow

You’ll receive mentoring, code review and practical experience across the software development lifecycle. As you demonstrate engineering capability and measurable impact, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to increasingly complex systems and broader product development, based on your readiness and team needs.
Success means solving today’s problems while building software that reduces tomorrow’s manual work.

title: AI Delivery Lead, Senior
descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is at the forefront of innovation, and as engineering paradigms shift toward AI-first delivery, we are seeking an experienced and dynamic AI Delivery Lead to act as the catalyst for our transformation. You will pioneer and orchestrate the AI Software Development Life Cycle (AI SDLC), integrating cutting-edge tools (LLMs, AI agents, AI-assisted development) into daily operations across multiple engineering teams. Beyond strategic oversight, this is a deeply hands-on technical coaching role: you will actively model best practices, elevate individual and team capabilities through real-code coaching, and guide developers in practical engineering scenarios. By combining deep technical expertise, modern delivery practices, and a commitment to code craftsmanship, you will shape the future of product delivery and cultivate a culture of engineering excellence at Salesforce.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Champion the AI SDLC: Influence the definition and drive the adoption of an AI-first strategy by defining and orchestrating a modern AI Software Development Life Cycle. Guide teams in seamlessly integrating Generative AI, agent-based frameworks, and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, OpenCode) into their daily workflows.
  • Hands-On Technical Coaching: Actively model and teach modern software craftsmanship. Facilitate real-code coaching, collaborative engineering sessions, and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to build mastery within engineering teams.
  • Proactive Stakeholder Engagement & Organizational Navigation: Initiate proactive outreach across complex, large-scale organizations to identify key stakeholders and establish self-introductions with senior leadership. Dynamically evaluate and adapt to evolving organizational landscapes, building trusted, influential relationships to seamlessly guide cross-functional teams.
  • Elevate Code Craft & Quality: Demonstrate expertise in design patterns, refactoring techniques, and clean code principles. Work directly with developers to elevate code maintainability and delivery speed using both foundational principles and modern AI tooling.
  • Optimize Delivery & Governance: Leverage data analytics to optimize workflows, continuously track delivery, and ensure AI initiatives yield real business value. Instill robust engineering practices and provide guardrails for safe, high-quality AI experimentation.
  • Drive Delivery Transformation: Serve as a proactive problem-solver and change agent. Identify and remove obstacles using AI tools to detect early delivery warning signs, guiding teams through complex technical transitions.
  • Influence and Communicate: Act as an exceptional communicator with excellent written and spoken skills. Highly comfortable speaking publicly with moderate size to 100+ person audiences. Adept at translating highly technical concepts into clear, inspiring messaging for both executive and engineering audiences.



You're Our Person If...

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 10+ years of technical product management, software development, or technical coaching experience, with a track record of delivering large-scale, high-impact digital products.

Join Product Operations to own licensing and entitlements for new product launches at Salesforce. You'll turn packaging and pricing decisions into the licenses, entitlements, and selling rules that shape how customers, sellers, and operators experience our products. You'll partner with Pricing Strategy, Product Management, Engineering, Finance, and Sales Operations, and your business requirements will influence the roadmap for our provisioning systems. This is a hybrid role with three days in office each week.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Own licensing and entitlement design for launches. Define the entitlement model for each offer: which features are on, which limits apply, and how capacity is provisioned and enforced.
  • Recommend license and entitlement structures to Product and Pricing teams, tying each option back to the business outcome you want.
  • Validate license and entitlement compatibility, and make sure each one maps correctly to license containers and to SKU and product records in our CRM.
  • Keep traceability from SKU to license to entitlement to feature, so every sellable item provisions what the customer bought.
  • Partner with Engineering and Provisioning on how entitlements behave in the product, including hard vs. soft limits, overage handling, and trial-to-paid conversion.
  • Build licensing governance into the NPI process for all new launches and repackaging efforts, moving strategy and technical validation earlier. Own license and entitlement sign-off for launches.
  • Train Product Operations project leads to run baseline project-level reviews, and rebalance review work between them and this role as NPI volume changes.
  • Create operating standards, including QA checklists, configuration menu options, and use cases. Develop enablement materials that support scalable, agentic question answering for product and pricing stakeholders.
  • Close current licensing gaps. Define an ownership model for cross-cloud licensing decisions between Product and Prod Ops (including legacy products), with a clear split of responsibility between Prod Ops and the Platform team. Build an M&A licensing playbook for bringing acquired-company user licensing into our model.
  • Assess financial and operational impact. Evaluate how usage-based pricing affects ACV, bookings, revenue recognition, forecasting, and sales compensation. Work with Finance, Deal Desk, and Sales Comp so new models fit approval workflows, discounting rules, and quota crediting.
  • Assess the experience each design creates for customers (buying, provisioning, usage visibility), sellers (quoting, configuration), and internal operators (order management, support, renewals).
  • Translate technical licensing capabilities and constraints into clear business terms, covering options, tradeoffs, and recommendations. Bring feasibility issues into packaging discussions early, before launch commitments are made.
  • Write and maintain launch documentation, standards, and playbooks. Build and maintain a central licensing resource with our provisioning team that shows which tools exist, who owns what, and how licensing choices affect commercial outcomes.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 7+ years in product management, engineering, commercial operations, IT, or a similar role at a SaaS or enterprise software company, including 2+ years leading technical cross-functional programs.
  • You have experience constructing licensing or entitlements for B2B SaaS, or experience in the product and engineering development lifecycle for SaaS products.
  • You've taken new products or pricing models from packaging concept to launch as a product manager or engineer.
  • You can develop business and technical requirements that drive the product and engineering roadmap for license construction, data model enhancements, and stakeholder tooling.
  • You can read, write, and troubleshoot XML (structure, attributes, namespaces, schema validation) and catch errors in license and entitlement definitions before they reach production.
  • You use SOQL, SQL, and AI tools to query product, license, and entitlement data, find mapping gaps, and audit catalog consistency.
  • You can master the data model for licenses and entitlements and drive requirements to update it as commercial and product needs evolve.
  • You work with source control (e.g., Git) and structured engineering release processes for configuration changes.



Even Better If...

  • You're familiar with metadata-driven platforms such as Salesforce metadata and CPQ/Revenue Cloud.
  • You've set structure and standards in ambiguous environments where none existed.
  • You can go deep on license mechanics with engineers, then summarize the decision and its impact for executives in a few sentences.

The Manager of Product & Pricing Operations leads the execution layer of the team responsible for product configuration, pricing systems, and operational readiness across the Lead-to-Cash cycle. This role requires hands-on knowledge of Salesforce Product, Pricing, and Quoting methodologies and data models. It also requires a strong ability to drive cross-functional programs from requirements through go-live, and the judgment to translate complex technical topics clearly to Finance, Legal, IT, and Product stakeholders.
Day-to-day responsibilities include scoping and executing product configuration requirements, managing cross-functional operational workflows, and ensuring CPQ and billing systems are validated and operationally ready before any initiative goes live.
Decisions made in this role are expected to account for downstream impact across the business function, and recurring issues or policy gaps should be surfaced proactively to leadership with a recommended path forward.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

1. Program Release Operations

  • Generate System and Process Requirements: Engage with IT and Business Partners to manage business requirements for solutions that impact Product and Pricing systems and processes. Influence cross-functional programs to ensure that outcomes match requirements and are successfully incorporated into new and pre-existing processes.
  • Operational Readiness: Validate that quoting, invoicing, and provisioning systems are fully configured and tested before go-live. Identify and escalate gaps with a clear resolution path.
  • NPI Program Support: Provide support for New Product Introduction (NPI) cycles across Product Management, Legal, Finance, and IT. Track cross-functional dependencies, surface blockers early, and hold teams accountable to shared milestones. Understand licensing and packaging implications well enough to advise Product Managers on downstream operational impact.
  • Change Management: Develop and deliver the documentation, training, and office hours that help the team and cross-functional partners adopt system and process changes. Treat go-live as complete only when the people involved can operate the new process independently.
  • Enablement: Build and maintain a culture of documentation and knowledge-sharing. When the team learns something new, whether a process change, a system update, or a configuration pattern, document it and make it accessible to others.

2. Support & Implementation

  • CPQ Systems: Maintain working knowledge of the CPQ ecosystem sufficient to configure, test, and troubleshoot independently. Identify and implement improvements that reduce manual steps and improve quoting accuracy. Monitor system health and ensure that data issues, system bugs, and feature requests are prioritized and owned appropriately.
  • Backlog Prioritization: Work with leadership to translate organizational priorities into a structured team backlog. Own the prioritization process and communicate tradeoffs clearly when capacity is constrained. Consider the broader business context and cross-functional dependencies when sequencing work, not just internal team capacity.
  • Cross-Functional Engagement: Represent Product & Pricing Operations in multi-functional planning forums. Serve as the primary point of contact for partners in Finance, Legal, IT, and Product Management on operational questions and requirements.

3. Pricing Configuration & Data Integrity

  • Cross-Functional Workflow Management: Own operational workflows that span Product Management, Legal, Finance, and IT. Maintain clear process documentation, approval routing, and accountability across stakeholders to keep work moving without bottlenecks.
  • Data Governance: Define and enforce data quality standards for product and pricing data in Org62. Run proactive validation checks, identify anomalies, document findings, and drive resolution with the appropriate system owners. Identify systemic data quality issues and escalate patterns and recommended remediation to leadership before they affect downstream systems or business decisions.

4. Process Improvement, Innovation & AI-Driven Operations

  • Process Improvement: Identify specific sources of friction in the Lead-to-Cash cycle. Scope and drive targeted fixes with clearly defined owners, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Innovation within Scope: Proactively identify opportunities to modernize how the team works, whether that means redesigning a data model, replacing a manual process with an automated one, or piloting a new approach to operational readiness. This is not limited to reacting to problems, but also includes bringing new ideas forward and building the case for them.
  • AI & Automation Adoption: Identify and pilot AI and automation tools that improve operational workflows. Build a team cadence around evaluating new tools, sharing findings, and measuring impact. Advocate for adoption based on demonstrated value, not novelty.
  • Execution Management: Maintain current documentation of requirements, risks, and system dependencies for active projects. Escalate issues that genuinely threaten a launch timeline. Communicate status in a format and frequency appropriate to the audience.


You're Our Person If...

  • Experience: 5+ years in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, or a related function.
  • Salesforce Expertise: Hands-on experience with Salesforce product configuration objects (Product2, Price Books, CPQ). Salesforce Admin or CPQ certification preferred.
  • Program Execution: Demonstrated experience running multi-dependency programs (product release cycles, system releases, data migrations) from requirements through go-live. Ability to manage scope, track dependencies, and close out work completely.
  • Data Skills: Proficiency working directly in data tools including SOQL, Excel, and Tableau to validate configurations, identify issues, and support decisions with evidence.
  • Communication: Ability to translate technical topics for non-technical stakeholders accurately and concisely. Comfortable preparing written documentation and presenting to cross-functional partners.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong track record of managing multiple parallel workstreams, identifying risks proactively, and following through without requiring follow-up.
  • Innovation Mindset: Demonstrated ability to identify gaps in existing processes or systems and bring forward concrete proposals to address them. Experience successfully implementing a process or tooling change that improved team efficiency is a plus.
  • AI & Automation: Interest in applying AI tools to operational workflows. Prior experience piloting or implementing AI tools in a business setting is a plus.

descriptionHtml:

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You’ll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You’ll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you’re looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn’t it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers’ time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You’ve built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You’ve implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platfororm

These demonstration environments incorporate the latest product capabilities that Salesforce has to offer. With these demo environments, SEs have the baseline demo that they need to deliver a best practice demo for Financial Services and enable our SEs to scale, innovate and provide the best product demonstrations of their careers.

Role Description: We are looking for a strong release manager to join our SE team, responsible for the Financial Services AMER Industry Demo Org. In this role you would own the demo environment from idea to reality, project managing the demo creation process including managing a product backlog, use case/feature prioritization, storyboarding, validation, demo build, release communication and enablement.

This role is for someone who doesn't just manage releases, they help define what's possible. You will play a key role in shaping how AI-powered demos, open source assets, and intelligent agents are built and delivered to our SE community. This is your chance to define the future and set the standard for how Salesforce solution engineers demonstrate our solutions to Financial Services prospects and customers.

If you are passionate about driving innovation, fostering collaboration, and shaping the future of demo environments, we invite you to join us. Together, let's empower SEs to excel in showcasing the latest product capabilities through innovative demos.

Key Job Responsibilities -

Release Management:

* Proven success managing cross-functional, multi-workstream projects to on-time completion.

* Plan and manage releases of FINS industry demo org releases, ensuring timely delivery of changes and enhancements.

* Coordinate release content and effort based on service requests, third-party applications, and system updates.

* Ensure quality control through comprehensive testing and defect resolution processes.

* Continuously improve release processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Salesforce Product Expertise:

* Utilize Salesforce metadata configuration tools to design and deploy custom applications and solutions.

* Collaborate with developers to leverage Salesforce metadata configuration for seamless integration and deployment.

* Ensure that Salesforce metadata components are aligned with overall release plans, business objectives, and organizational best practices.

OmniStudio Expertise:

* Utilize Salesforce OmniStudio tools to design and deploy custom applications and solutions.

* Collaborate with developers to leverage OmniStudio's capabilities for seamless integration and deployment.

* Ensure that OmniStudio components are aligned with overall release plans, business objectives, and organizational best practices.

* Ability to identify opportunities where AI agents can enhance demo narratives, automate workflows, or personalize the SE experience.

* Stay current on Agentforce capabilities, prompt engineering best practices, and the evolving landscape of AI tooling within the Salesforce ecosystem.

* Own and manage code repositories (GitHub, GitLab, or equivalent) for demo org assets, ensuring clean branching strategies, versioning, and documentation standards.

* Document release procedures, guidelines, and lessons learned.

* Leverage AI tools to accelerate documentation creation, keeping pace with rapid release cycles.

* Strong understanding of Salesforce development lifecycle and deployment methodologies.

* At least one year of hands-on experience with Salesforce OmniStudio tools, including FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures.

* Familiarity with Agentforce or equivalent AI agent platforms, with a curiosity and drive to deepen that expertise.

* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

* Experience with CI/CD tools and automation (GitHub Actions, Salesforce DX, CumulusCI, or similar).

* Experience creating or contributing to open source projects, including documentation and community-facing release packaging.

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


The Experience


Build at enterprise scale. Launch like a founder. Start this summer.


Salesforce AI Labs is seeking exceptional emerging AI and computer science talent for our highly selective, 12-week summer internship designed to develop the next generation of AI builders.


As an AI Labs intern, you'll spend 12 weeks embedded in one of four disciplines, tackling real technical, product, or customer challenges, building with frontier AI technologies, and contributing to solutions at enterprise scale. You'll work alongside experienced researchers, engineers, product managers, and technical leaders, with access to AI-native development tools and opportunities to take meaningful ownership of your work.


Interns will be placed in one of four disciplines:

  • Build (Product Engineering): Design, build, and ship AI-powered products, developing technical expertise in production-scale engineering.
  • Shape (Product Management): Translate customer needs into product strategy, define priorities, and help shape the next generation of AI products.
  • Deliver (FDE / Builders): Work with teams developing and deploying AI solutions that solve real-world customer challenges.
  • Transform (DET / Customer Zero): Reimagine enterprise workflows and operations, leveraging AI to drive transformation at scale.

While you'll spend the summer gaining hands-on experience in one discipline, you'll also collaborate with interns across the other three disciplines on a cross-functional capstone project. Together, you'll bring engineering, product strategy, customer solutions, and enterprise transformation perspectives to a shared AI challenge, culminating in a final presentation at Demo Day.


The internship provides an opportunity to build technical depth, develop a broader understanding of the AI lifecycle, and experience how cross-functional teams bring innovative solutions to life.


This internship is designed as a feeder into the 24-month AI Labs Rotational Fellowship, where Fellows complete four six-month rotations across Build, Shape, Deliver, and Transform. Interns who demonstrate strong performance and potential may be considered for full-time opportunities in the Fellowship following graduation.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build and Deliver AI Solutions: Spend 12 weeks embedded in one AI Labs discipline, contributing to meaningful projects that solve real technical, product, or customer challenges.
  • Work with Frontier AI: Gain hands-on experience with AI-native development tools, AI agents, and emerging technologies to accelerate experimentation, development, and problem-solving.
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner with interns from Build, Shape, Deliver, and Transform on a cross-functional capstone project, combining different perspectives to develop an innovative AI solution.
  • Own Meaningful Work: Take ownership of assigned projects, from problem definition and experimentation through development and delivery, with guidance from experienced AI Labs leaders.
  • Present Your Work: Showcase your team's capstone project at an in-person Demo Day, presenting your solution, approach, and impact to an executive panel.
  • Learn from AI Leaders: Engage with engineering, product, FDE, and DET teams through mentorship, workshops, and cohort experiences that broaden your understanding of the AI lifecycle.

You're Our Person If...

  • Computer Science & Engineering Fundamentals: Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028. Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software engineering, and technical problem-solving.
  • Practical Coding Experience: Experience developing software through academic projects, research, internships, or independent technical projects.
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python and experience building software, AI, or machine learning applications.
  • AI & ML Foundations: Understanding of core AI/ML concepts and experience using modern AI development tools to accelerate experimentation, development, and problem-solving.
  • Builder Mindset: Demonstrated curiosity, high ownership, and ability to solve complex problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across disciplines and explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Product influence: Experience synthesizing customer needs across markets into prioritized product recommendations and collaborating with product management to influence roadmaps.

They will turn these perspectives into reusable industry assets and guidance and mentor technical teams.
  • Develop trusted C-level customer relationships: They will build and sustain trusted relationships with C-level leaders at key ASEAN customers, acting as an industry technology advisor on investment, enterprise architecture, and transformation while building preference for Salesforce.
  • Support strategic growth: They will partner with sales and solution engineering on major opportunities, business cases, and executive engagement.
  • Represent ASEAN customers in product development: They will act as the conduit to Salesforce Product Management, translating regional customer needs into prioritized recommendations that shape product roadmaps and development. They will close the feedback loop with customers and account teams.

  • Apply competitive insight: They will monitor Salesforce’s competitive landscape and customers’ market dynamics to inform positioning, technology choices, and differentiation strategies.


You’re Our Person If...
An ideal candidate would demonstrate:

  • Customer-focused and commercially minded: An ability to understand customers’ ambitions and competitive pressures, represent their needs, and connect recommendations to measurable outcomes.
  • Credible and collaborative: Clear communication, objective assessment of alternatives, constructive challenge, and an ability to build trust across customers, product management, technical teams, and partners.
  • Founder mindset and ownership: A can-do attitude, a passion for AI, and a willingness to get hands-on. They would be resourceful, turn ambiguity into action, experiment thoughtfully, and own outcomes from idea through execution.

Even Better If...

An ideal candidate would have strong relevant industry / technology experience and would already be operating at Director level or demonstrate the leadership scope, executive influence, and track record to step into a Director role.   • Propose changes to systems and processes that address root causes, in partnership with the Workday Center of Excellence.

Spanning more than 30 countries, our Agentic Campus reflects our values and culture – bringing together humans, agents, and robots to create inclusive, purpose-driven spaces where people feel a true sense of belonging. As customer zero of Salesforce’s own technology, REWS is leading the way, creating innovative and dynamic spaces that provide seamless and inspiring workplace experiences.


The Experience

The REWS Workplace Innovation team is seeking a Workplace Research Manager to generate insights that enable REWS to continuously evolve and enhance employee and customer experiences across our offices. In this individual contributor role, you will be responsible for designing and executing end-to-end mixed-methods research, translating qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights that inform decisions across our global portfolio.

  • Reporting to the Senior Manager, Workplace Research, you will serve as a dedicated research partner and consultant across Workplace Innovation teams (Pilots, Space Insights) and other REWS stakeholders.
  • In this role, you will partner with the Pilots and Space Insights teams to evaluate workplace pilots—delivering the employee research workstream—while conducting collaborative exploratory research to inform emerging innovation initiatives.
  • You will leverage a versatile toolkit of qualitative and quantitative research skills while adopting AI tools and automated workflows to accelerate synthesis and deliver timely, high-impact insights.
  • This role is based in San Francisco, CA, Chicago, IL, or Atlanta, GA, and is eligible for an Office Flexible (3 days/week) work arrangement, with periodic domestic or international travel for on-site discovery activities or pilot fieldwork. 

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Collaborate with the Pilots and Space Insights teams across the pilot project lifecycle, from initial discovery and defining success metrics through to final readouts and recommendations. Within this collaborative structure, own the mixed-methods employee research workstream to design, field, and deliver baseline, in-flight, and post-pilot insights to evaluate new physical layouts, furniture concepts, workplace programs and technology.
  • Collaborate on exploratory discovery initiatives and conduct on-site qualitative fieldwork—such as in-depth interviews, discovery workshops, intercept interviews, guided walk-and-talks, and ethnographic research—to uncover unmet employee needs and understand the ‘why’ behind employee behaviors, adoption, or friction.
  • Partner closely with the Space Insights team to integrate multi-source evaluation data—layering objective spatial telemetry (such as occupancy patterns and room utilization metrics) with employee research findings and survey sentiment to co-develop clear, comprehensive recommendations for stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify and integrate AI tools and automated workflows across the research lifecycle to accelerate qualitative synthesis and reporting, staying current with industry workplace trends to inform research roadmaps.

You’re Our Person If…

  • 4+ years of applied research experience focusing on human-environment interactions, workplace strategy, environmental psychology, physical workplace experience, applied behavioral science, corporate real estate, or a related field with a strong mixed-methods research foundation.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and conducting mixed-methods studies to evaluate physical spaces, furniture, and workplace layouts, with a proven ability to assess the impact of workplace changes on employee sentiment and behavior across pre- and post-occupancy phases.
  • Hands-on experience conducting qualitative fieldwork using varied research methods to deeply understand employee needs, paired with strong quantitative data literacy to interpret and contextualize spatial metrics and numerical data alongside employee sentiment and qualitative feedback.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous business or workplace challenges into focused, agile research plans, manage multiple concurrent project timelines with flexibility, and synthesize disparate inputs into clear presentations for multidisciplinary partners.

Even Better If…

  • Knowledge of questionnaire design best practices and hands-on experience designing and fielding employee feedback and pilot evaluation surveys.
  • Experience using inferential statistics (such as significance testing, correlation, or regression) to analyze employee sentiment and survey datasets.
  • Deep understanding of corporate real estate fundamentals.
